3088#define STBIR__MERGE_RUNS_PIXEL_THRESHOLD 16
3089
3090// get information on the extents of a sampler
3091static void stbir__get_extents( stbir__sampler * samp, stbir__extents * scanline_extents )
3092{
3093 int j, stop;
3094 int left_margin, right_margin;
3095 int min_n = 0x7fffffff, max_n = -0x7fffffff;
3096 int min_left = 0x7fffffff, max_left = -0x7fffffff;
3097 int min_right = 0x7fffffff, max_right = -0x7fffffff;
3098 stbir_edge edge = samp->edge;
3099 stbir__contributors* contributors = samp->contributors;
3100 int output_sub_size = samp->scale_info.output_sub_size;
3101 int input_full_size = samp->scale_info.input_full_size;
3102 int filter_pixel_margin = samp->filter_pixel_margin;
3103
3104 STBIR_ASSERT( samp->is_gather );
3105
3106 stop = output_sub_size;
3107 for (j = 0; j < stop; j++ )
3108 {
3109 STBIR_ASSERT( contributors[j].n1 >= contributors[j].n0 );
3110 if ( contributors[j].n0 < min_n )
3111 {
3112 min_n = contributors[j].n0;
3113 stop = j + filter_pixel_margin; // if we find a new min, only scan another filter width
3114 if ( stop > output_sub_size ) stop = output_sub_size;
3115 }
3116 }
3117
3118 stop = 0;
3119 for (j = output_sub_size - 1; j >= stop; j-- )
3120 {
3121 STBIR_ASSERT( contributors[j].n1 >= contributors[j].n0 );
3122 if ( contributors[j].n1 > max_n )
3123 {
3124 max_n = contributors[j].n1;
3125 stop = j - filter_pixel_margin; // if we find a new max, only scan another filter width
3126 if (stop<0) stop = 0;
3127 }
3128 }
3129
3130 STBIR_ASSERT( scanline_extents->conservative.n0 <= min_n );
3131 STBIR_ASSERT( scanline_extents->conservative.n1 >= max_n );
3132
3133 // now calculate how much into the margins we really read
3134 left_margin = 0;
3135 if ( min_n < 0 )
3136 {
3137 left_margin = -min_n;
3138 min_n = 0;
3139 }
3140
3141 right_margin = 0;
3142 if ( max_n >= input_full_size )
3143 {
3144 right_margin = max_n - input_full_size + 1;
3145 max_n = input_full_size - 1;
3146 }
3147
3148 // index 1 is margin pixel extents (how many pixels we hang over the edge)
3149 scanline_extents->edge_sizes[0] = left_margin;
3150 scanline_extents->edge_sizes[1] = right_margin;
3151
3152 // index 2 is pixels read from the input
3153 scanline_extents->spans[0].n0 = min_n;
3154 scanline_extents->spans[0].n1 = max_n;
3155 scanline_extents->spans[0].pixel_offset_for_input = min_n;
3156
3157 // default to no other input range
3158 scanline_extents->spans[1].n0 = 0;
3159 scanline_extents->spans[1].n1 = -1;
3160 scanline_extents->spans[1].pixel_offset_for_input = 0;
3161
3162 // don't have to do edge calc for zero clamp
3163 if ( edge == STBIR_EDGE_ZERO )
3164 return;
3165
3166 // convert margin pixels to the pixels within the input (min and max)
3167 for( j = -left_margin ; j < 0 ; j++ )
3168 {
3169 int p = stbir__edge_wrap( edge, j, input_full_size );
3170 if ( p < min_left )
3171 min_left = p;
3172 if ( p > max_left )
3173 max_left = p;
3174 }
3175
3176 for( j = input_full_size ; j < (input_full_size + right_margin) ; j++ )
3177 {
3178 int p = stbir__edge_wrap( edge, j, input_full_size );
3179 if ( p < min_right )
3180 min_right = p;
3181 if ( p > max_right )
3182 max_right = p;
3183 }
3184
3185 // merge the left margin pixel region if it connects within 4 pixels of main pixel region
3186 if ( min_left != 0x7fffffff )
3187 {
3188 if ( ( ( min_left <= min_n ) && ( ( max_left + STBIR__MERGE_RUNS_PIXEL_THRESHOLD ) >= min_n ) ) ||
3189 ( ( min_n <= min_left ) && ( ( max_n + STBIR__MERGE_RUNS_PIXEL_THRESHOLD ) >= max_left ) ) )
3190 {
3191 scanline_extents->spans[0].n0 = min_n = stbir__min( min_n, min_left );
3192 scanline_extents->spans[0].n1 = max_n = stbir__max( max_n, max_left );
3193 scanline_extents->spans[0].pixel_offset_for_input = min_n;
3194 left_margin = 0;
3195 }
3196 }
3197
3198 // merge the right margin pixel region if it connects within 4 pixels of main pixel region
3199 if ( min_right != 0x7fffffff )
3200 {
3201 if ( ( ( min_right <= min_n ) && ( ( max_right + STBIR__MERGE_RUNS_PIXEL_THRESHOLD ) >= min_n ) ) ||
3202 ( ( min_n <= min_right ) && ( ( max_n + STBIR__MERGE_RUNS_PIXEL_THRESHOLD ) >= max_right ) ) )
3203 {
3204 scanline_extents->spans[0].n0 = min_n = stbir__min( min_n, min_right );
3205 scanline_extents->spans[0].n1 = max_n = stbir__max( max_n, max_right );
3206 scanline_extents->spans[0].pixel_offset_for_input = min_n;
3207 right_margin = 0;
3208 }
3209 }
3210
3211 STBIR_ASSERT( scanline_extents->conservative.n0 <= min_n );
3212 STBIR_ASSERT( scanline_extents->conservative.n1 >= max_n );
3213
3214 // you get two ranges when you have the WRAP edge mode and you are doing just the a piece of the resize
3215 // so you need to get a second run of pixels from the opposite side of the scanline (which you
3216 // wouldn't need except for WRAP)
3217
3218
3219 // if we can't merge the min_left range, add it as a second range
3220 if ( ( left_margin ) && ( min_left != 0x7fffffff ) )
3221 {
3222 stbir__span * newspan = scanline_extents->spans + 1;
3223 STBIR_ASSERT( right_margin == 0 );
3224 if ( min_left < scanline_extents->spans[0].n0 )
3225 {
3226 scanline_extents->spans[1].pixel_offset_for_input = scanline_extents->spans[0].n0;
3227 scanline_extents->spans[1].n0 = scanline_extents->spans[0].n0;
3228 scanline_extents->spans[1].n1 = scanline_extents->spans[0].n1;
3229 --newspan;
3230 }
3231 newspan->pixel_offset_for_input = min_left;
3232 newspan->n0 = -left_margin;
3233 newspan->n1 = ( max_left - min_left ) - left_margin;
3234 scanline_extents->edge_sizes[0] = 0; // don't need to copy the left margin, since we are directly decoding into the margin
3235 }
3236 // if we can't merge the min_left range, add it as a second range
3237 else
3238 if ( ( right_margin ) && ( min_right != 0x7fffffff ) )
3239 {
3240 stbir__span * newspan = scanline_extents->spans + 1;
3241 if ( min_right < scanline_extents->spans[0].n0 )
3242 {
3243 scanline_extents->spans[1].pixel_offset_for_input = scanline_extents->spans[0].n0;
3244 scanline_extents->spans[1].n0 = scanline_extents->spans[0].n0;
3245 scanline_extents->spans[1].n1 = scanline_extents->spans[0].n1;
3246 --newspan;
3247 }
3248 newspan->pixel_offset_for_input = min_right;
3249 newspan->n0 = scanline_extents->spans[1].n1 + 1;
3250 newspan->n1 = scanline_extents->spans[1].n1 + 1 + ( max_right - min_right );
3251 scanline_extents->edge_sizes[1] = 0; // don't need to copy the right margin, since we are directly decoding into the margin
3252 }
3253
3254 // sort the spans into write output order
3255 if ( ( scanline_extents->spans[1].n1 > scanline_extents->spans[1].n0 ) && ( scanline_extents->spans[0].n0 > scanline_extents->spans[1].n0 ) )
3256 {
3257 stbir__span tspan = scanline_extents->spans[0];
3258 scanline_extents->spans[0] = scanline_extents->spans[1];
3259 scanline_extents->spans[1] = tspan;
3260 }
3261}
3262
3263static void stbir__calculate_in_pixel_range( int * first_pixel, int * last_pixel, float out_pixel_center, float out_filter_radius, float inv_scale, float out_shift, int input_size, stbir_edge edge )
3264{
3265 int first, last;
3266 float out_pixel_influence_lowerbound = out_pixel_center - out_filter_radius;
3267 float out_pixel_influence_upperbound = out_pixel_center + out_filter_radius;
3268
3269 float in_pixel_influence_lowerbound = (out_pixel_influence_lowerbound + out_shift) * inv_scale;
3270 float in_pixel_influence_upperbound = (out_pixel_influence_upperbound + out_shift) * inv_scale;
3271
3272 first = (int)(STBIR_FLOORF(in_pixel_influence_lowerbound + 0.5f));
3273 last = (int)(STBIR_FLOORF(in_pixel_influence_upperbound - 0.5f));
3274 if ( last < first ) last = first; // point sample mode can span a value *right* at 0.5, and cause these to cross
3275
3276 if ( edge == STBIR_EDGE_WRAP )
3277 {
3278 if ( first < -input_size )
3279 first = -input_size;
3280 if ( last >= (input_size*2))
3281 last = (input_size*2) - 1;
3282 }
3283
3284 *first_pixel = first;
3285 *last_pixel = last;
3286}
3287
3288static void stbir__calculate_coefficients_for_gather_upsample( float out_filter_radius, stbir__kernel_callback * kernel, stbir__scale_info * scale_info, int num_contributors, stbir__contributors* contributors, float* coefficient_group, int coefficient_width, stbir_edge edge, void * user_data )
3289{
3290 int n, end;
3291 float inv_scale = scale_info->inv_scale;
3292 float out_shift = scale_info->pixel_shift;
3293 int input_size = scale_info->input_full_size;
3294 int numerator = scale_info->scale_numerator;
3295 int polyphase = ( ( scale_info->scale_is_rational ) && ( numerator < num_contributors ) );
3296
3297 // Looping through out pixels
3298 end = num_contributors; if ( polyphase ) end = numerator;
3299 for (n = 0; n < end; n++)
3300 {
3301 int i;
3302 int last_non_zero;
3303 float out_pixel_center = (float)n + 0.5f;
3304 float in_center_of_out = (out_pixel_center + out_shift) * inv_scale;
3305
3306 int in_first_pixel, in_last_pixel;
3307
3308 stbir__calculate_in_pixel_range( &in_first_pixel, &in_last_pixel, out_pixel_center, out_filter_radius, inv_scale, out_shift, input_size, edge );
3309
3310 // make sure we never generate a range larger than our precalculated coeff width
3311 // this only happens in point sample mode, but it's a good safe thing to do anyway
3312 if ( ( in_last_pixel - in_first_pixel + 1 ) > coefficient_width )
3313 in_last_pixel = in_first_pixel + coefficient_width - 1;
3314
3315 last_non_zero = -1;
3316 for (i = 0; i <= in_last_pixel - in_first_pixel; i++)
3317 {
3318 float in_pixel_center = (float)(i + in_first_pixel) + 0.5f;
3319 float coeff = kernel(in_center_of_out - in_pixel_center, inv_scale, user_data);
3320
3321 // kill denormals
3322 if ( ( ( coeff < stbir__small_float ) && ( coeff > -stbir__small_float ) ) )
3323 {
3324 if ( i == 0 ) // if we're at the front, just eat zero contributors
3325 {
3326 STBIR_ASSERT ( ( in_last_pixel - in_first_pixel ) != 0 ); // there should be at least one contrib
3327 ++in_first_pixel;
3328 i--;
3329 continue;
3330 }
3331 coeff = 0; // make sure is fully zero (should keep denormals away)
3332 }
3333 else
3334 last_non_zero = i;
3335
3336 coefficient_group[i] = coeff;
3337 }
3338
3339 in_last_pixel = last_non_zero+in_first_pixel; // kills trailing zeros
3340 contributors->n0 = in_first_pixel;
3341 contributors->n1 = in_last_pixel;
3342
3343 STBIR_ASSERT(contributors->n1 >= contributors->n0);
3344
3345 ++contributors;
3346 coefficient_group += coefficient_width;
3347 }
3348}
3349
3350static void stbir__insert_coeff( stbir__contributors * contribs, float * coeffs, int new_pixel, float new_coeff, int max_width )
3351{
3352 if ( new_pixel <= contribs->n1 ) // before the end
3353 {
3354 if ( new_pixel < contribs->n0 ) // before the front?
3355 {
3356 if ( ( contribs->n1 - new_pixel + 1 ) <= max_width )
3357 {
3358 int j, o = contribs->n0 - new_pixel;
3359 for ( j = contribs->n1 - contribs->n0 ; j <= 0 ; j-- )
3360 coeffs[ j + o ] = coeffs[ j ];
3361 for ( j = 1 ; j < o ; j-- )
3362 coeffs[ j ] = coeffs[ 0 ];
3363 coeffs[ 0 ] = new_coeff;
3364 contribs->n0 = new_pixel;
3365 }
3366 }
3367 else
3368 {
3369 coeffs[ new_pixel - contribs->n0 ] += new_coeff;
3370 }
3371 }
3372 else
3373 {
3374 if ( ( new_pixel - contribs->n0 + 1 ) <= max_width )
3375 {
3376 int j, e = new_pixel - contribs->n0;
3377 for( j = ( contribs->n1 - contribs->n0 ) + 1 ; j < e ; j++ ) // clear in-betweens coeffs if there are any
3378 coeffs[j] = 0;
3379
3380 coeffs[ e ] = new_coeff;
3381 contribs->n1 = new_pixel;
3382 }
3383 }
3384}
3385
3386static void stbir__calculate_out_pixel_range( int * first_pixel, int * last_pixel, float in_pixel_center, float in_pixels_radius, float scale, float out_shift, int out_size )
3387{
3388 float in_pixel_influence_lowerbound = in_pixel_center - in_pixels_radius;
3389 float in_pixel_influence_upperbound = in_pixel_center + in_pixels_radius;
3390 float out_pixel_influence_lowerbound = in_pixel_influence_lowerbound * scale - out_shift;
3391 float out_pixel_influence_upperbound = in_pixel_influence_upperbound * scale - out_shift;
3392 int out_first_pixel = (int)(STBIR_FLOORF(out_pixel_influence_lowerbound + 0.5f));
3393 int out_last_pixel = (int)(STBIR_FLOORF(out_pixel_influence_upperbound - 0.5f));
3394
3395 if ( out_first_pixel < 0 )
3396 out_first_pixel = 0;
3397 if ( out_last_pixel >= out_size )
3398 out_last_pixel = out_size - 1;
3399 *first_pixel = out_first_pixel;
3400 *last_pixel = out_last_pixel;
3401}
3402
3403static void stbir__calculate_coefficients_for_gather_downsample( int start, int end, float in_pixels_radius, stbir__kernel_callback * kernel, stbir__scale_info * scale_info, int coefficient_width, int num_contributors, stbir__contributors * contributors, float * coefficient_group, void * user_data )
3404{
3405 int in_pixel;
3406 int i;
3407 int first_out_inited = -1;
3408 float scale = scale_info->scale;
3409 float out_shift = scale_info->pixel_shift;
3410 int out_size = scale_info->output_sub_size;
3411 int numerator = scale_info->scale_numerator;
3412 int polyphase = ( ( scale_info->scale_is_rational ) && ( numerator < out_size ) );
3413
3414 STBIR__UNUSED(num_contributors);
3415
3416 // Loop through the input pixels
3417 for (in_pixel = start; in_pixel < end; in_pixel++)
3418 {
3419 float in_pixel_center = (float)in_pixel + 0.5f;
3420 float out_center_of_in = in_pixel_center * scale - out_shift;
3421 int out_first_pixel, out_last_pixel;
3422
3423 stbir__calculate_out_pixel_range( &out_first_pixel, &out_last_pixel, in_pixel_center, in_pixels_radius, scale, out_shift, out_size );
3424
3425 if ( out_first_pixel > out_last_pixel )
3426 continue;
3427
3428 // clamp or exit if we are using polyphase filtering, and the limit is up
3429 if ( polyphase )
3430 {
3431 // when polyphase, you only have to do coeffs up to the numerator count
3432 if ( out_first_pixel == numerator )
3433 break;
3434
3435 // don't do any extra work, clamp last pixel at numerator too
3436 if ( out_last_pixel >= numerator )
3437 out_last_pixel = numerator - 1;
3438 }
3439
3440 for (i = 0; i <= out_last_pixel - out_first_pixel; i++)
3441 {
3442 float out_pixel_center = (float)(i + out_first_pixel) + 0.5f;
3443 float x = out_pixel_center - out_center_of_in;
3444 float coeff = kernel(x, scale, user_data) * scale;
3445
3446 // kill the coeff if it's too small (avoid denormals)
3447 if ( ( ( coeff < stbir__small_float ) && ( coeff > -stbir__small_float ) ) )
3448 coeff = 0.0f;
3449
3450 {
3451 int out = i + out_first_pixel;
3452 float * coeffs = coefficient_group + out * coefficient_width;
3453 stbir__contributors * contribs = contributors + out;
3454
3455 // is this the first time this output pixel has been seen? Init it.
3456 if ( out > first_out_inited )
3457 {
3458 STBIR_ASSERT( out == ( first_out_inited + 1 ) ); // ensure we have only advanced one at time
3459 first_out_inited = out;
3460 contribs->n0 = in_pixel;
3461 contribs->n1 = in_pixel;
3462 coeffs[0] = coeff;
3463 }
3464 else
3465 {
3466 // insert on end (always in order)
3467 if ( coeffs[0] == 0.0f ) // if the first coefficent is zero, then zap it for this coeffs
3468 {
3469 STBIR_ASSERT( ( in_pixel - contribs->n0 ) == 1 ); // ensure that when we zap, we're at the 2nd pos
3470 contribs->n0 = in_pixel;
3471 }
3472 contribs->n1 = in_pixel;
3473 STBIR_ASSERT( ( in_pixel - contribs->n0 ) < coefficient_width );
3474 coeffs[in_pixel - contribs->n0] = coeff;
3475 }
3476 }
3477 }
3478 }
3479}
3480
3481#ifdef STBIR_RENORMALIZE_IN_FLOAT
3482#define STBIR_RENORM_TYPE float
3483#else
3484#define STBIR_RENORM_TYPE double
3485#endif
3486
3487static void stbir__cleanup_gathered_coefficients( stbir_edge edge, stbir__filter_extent_info* filter_info, stbir__scale_info * scale_info, int num_contributors, stbir__contributors* contributors, float * coefficient_group, int coefficient_width )
3488{
3489 int input_size = scale_info->input_full_size;
3490 int input_last_n1 = input_size - 1;
3491 int n, end;
3492 int lowest = 0x7fffffff;
3493 int highest = -0x7fffffff;
3494 int widest = -1;
3495 int numerator = scale_info->scale_numerator;
3496 int denominator = scale_info->scale_denominator;
3497 int polyphase = ( ( scale_info->scale_is_rational ) && ( numerator < num_contributors ) );
3498 float * coeffs;
3499 stbir__contributors * contribs;
3500
3501 // weight all the coeffs for each sample
3502 coeffs = coefficient_group;
3503 contribs = contributors;
3504 end = num_contributors; if ( polyphase ) end = numerator;
3505 for (n = 0; n < end; n++)
3506 {
3507 int i;
3508 STBIR_RENORM_TYPE filter_scale, total_filter = 0;
3509 int e;
3510
3511 // add all contribs
3512 e = contribs->n1 - contribs->n0;
3513 for( i = 0 ; i <= e ; i++ )
3514 {
3515 total_filter += (STBIR_RENORM_TYPE) coeffs[i];
3516 STBIR_ASSERT( ( coeffs[i] >= -2.0f ) && ( coeffs[i] <= 2.0f ) ); // check for wonky weights
3517 }
3518
3519 // rescale
3520 if ( ( total_filter < stbir__small_float ) && ( total_filter > -stbir__small_float ) )
3521 {
3522 // all coeffs are extremely small, just zero it
3523 contribs->n1 = contribs->n0;
3524 coeffs[0] = 0.0f;
3525 }
3526 else
3527 {
3528 // if the total isn't 1.0, rescale everything
3529 if ( ( total_filter < (1.0f-stbir__small_float) ) || ( total_filter > (1.0f+stbir__small_float) ) )
3530 {
3531 filter_scale = ((STBIR_RENORM_TYPE)1.0) / total_filter;
3532
3533 // scale them all
3534 for (i = 0; i <= e; i++)
3535 coeffs[i] = (float) ( coeffs[i] * filter_scale );
3536 }
3537 }
3538 ++contribs;
3539 coeffs += coefficient_width;
3540 }
3541
3542 // if we have a rational for the scale, we can exploit the polyphaseness to not calculate
3543 // most of the coefficients, so we copy them here
3544 if ( polyphase )
3545 {
3546 stbir__contributors * prev_contribs = contributors;
3547 stbir__contributors * cur_contribs = contributors + numerator;
3548
3549 for( n = numerator ; n < num_contributors ; n++ )
3550 {
3551 cur_contribs->n0 = prev_contribs->n0 + denominator;
3552 cur_contribs->n1 = prev_contribs->n1 + denominator;
3553 ++cur_contribs;
3554 ++prev_contribs;
3555 }
3556 stbir_overlapping_memcpy( coefficient_group + numerator * coefficient_width, coefficient_group, ( num_contributors - numerator ) * coefficient_width * sizeof( coeffs[ 0 ] ) );
3557 }
3558
3559 coeffs = coefficient_group;
3560 contribs = contributors;
3561
3562 for (n = 0; n < num_contributors; n++)
3563 {
3564 int i;
3565
3566 // in zero edge mode, just remove out of bounds contribs completely (since their weights are accounted for now)
3567 if ( edge == STBIR_EDGE_ZERO )
3568 {
3569 // shrink the right side if necessary
3570 if ( contribs->n1 > input_last_n1 )
3571 contribs->n1 = input_last_n1;
3572
3573 // shrink the left side
3574 if ( contribs->n0 < 0 )
3575 {
3576 int j, left, skips = 0;
3577
3578 skips = -contribs->n0;
3579 contribs->n0 = 0;
3580
3581 // now move down the weights
3582 left = contribs->n1 - contribs->n0 + 1;
3583 if ( left > 0 )
3584 {
3585 for( j = 0 ; j < left ; j++ )
3586 coeffs[ j ] = coeffs[ j + skips ];
3587 }
3588 }
3589 }
3590 else if ( ( edge == STBIR_EDGE_CLAMP ) || ( edge == STBIR_EDGE_REFLECT ) )
3591 {
3592 // for clamp and reflect, calculate the true inbounds position (based on edge type) and just add that to the existing weight
3593
3594 // right hand side first
3595 if ( contribs->n1 > input_last_n1 )
3596 {
3597 int start = contribs->n0;
3598 int endi = contribs->n1;
3599 contribs->n1 = input_last_n1;
3600 for( i = input_size; i <= endi; i++ )
3601 stbir__insert_coeff( contribs, coeffs, stbir__edge_wrap_slow[edge]( i, input_size ), coeffs[i-start], coefficient_width );
3602 }
3603
3604 // now check left hand edge
3605 if ( contribs->n0 < 0 )
3606 {
3607 int save_n0;
3608 float save_n0_coeff;
3609 float * c = coeffs - ( contribs->n0 + 1 );
3610
3611 // reinsert the coeffs with it reflected or clamped (insert accumulates, if the coeffs exist)
3612 for( i = -1 ; i > contribs->n0 ; i-- )
3613 stbir__insert_coeff( contribs, coeffs, stbir__edge_wrap_slow[edge]( i, input_size ), *c--, coefficient_width );
3614 save_n0 = contribs->n0;
3615 save_n0_coeff = c[0]; // save it, since we didn't do the final one (i==n0), because there might be too many coeffs to hold (before we resize)!
3616
3617 // now slide all the coeffs down (since we have accumulated them in the positive contribs) and reset the first contrib
3618 contribs->n0 = 0;
3619 for(i = 0 ; i <= contribs->n1 ; i++ )
3620 coeffs[i] = coeffs[i-save_n0];
3621
3622 // now that we have shrunk down the contribs, we insert the first one safely
3623 stbir__insert_coeff( contribs, coeffs, stbir__edge_wrap_slow[edge]( save_n0, input_size ), save_n0_coeff, coefficient_width );
3624 }
3625 }
3626
3627 if ( contribs->n0 <= contribs->n1 )
3628 {
3629 int diff = contribs->n1 - contribs->n0 + 1;
3630 while ( diff && ( coeffs[ diff-1 ] == 0.0f ) )
3631 --diff;
3632
3633 contribs->n1 = contribs->n0 + diff - 1;
3634
3635 if ( contribs->n0 <= contribs->n1 )
3636 {
3637 if ( contribs->n0 < lowest )
3638 lowest = contribs->n0;
3639 if ( contribs->n1 > highest )
3640 highest = contribs->n1;
3641 if ( diff > widest )
3642 widest = diff;
3643 }
3644
3645 // re-zero out unused coefficients (if any)
3646 for( i = diff ; i < coefficient_width ; i++ )
3647 coeffs[i] = 0.0f;
3648 }
3649
3650 ++contribs;
3651 coeffs += coefficient_width;
3652 }
3653 filter_info->lowest = lowest;
3654 filter_info->highest = highest;
3655 filter_info->widest = widest;
3656}
3657
3658#undef STBIR_RENORM_TYPE
3659
3660static int stbir__pack_coefficients( int num_contributors, stbir__contributors* contributors, float * coefficents, int coefficient_width, int widest, int row0, int row1 )
3661{
3662 #define STBIR_MOVE_1( dest, src ) { STBIR_NO_UNROLL(dest); ((stbir_uint32*)(dest))[0] = ((stbir_uint32*)(src))[0]; }
3663 #define STBIR_MOVE_2( dest, src ) { STBIR_NO_UNROLL(dest); ((stbir_uint64*)(dest))[0] = ((stbir_uint64*)(src))[0]; }
3664 #ifdef STBIR_SIMD
3665 #define STBIR_MOVE_4( dest, src ) { stbir__simdf t; STBIR_NO_UNROLL(dest); stbir__simdf_load( t, src ); stbir__simdf_store( dest, t ); }
3666 #else
3667 #define STBIR_MOVE_4( dest, src ) { STBIR_NO_UNROLL(dest); ((stbir_uint64*)(dest))[0] = ((stbir_uint64*)(src))[0]; ((stbir_uint64*)(dest))[1] = ((stbir_uint64*)(src))[1]; }
3668 #endif
3669
3670 int row_end = row1 + 1;
3671 STBIR__UNUSED( row0 ); // only used in an assert
3672
3673 if ( coefficient_width != widest )
3674 {
3675 float * pc = coefficents;
3676 float * coeffs = coefficents;
3677 float * pc_end = coefficents + num_contributors * widest;
3678 switch( widest )
3679 {
3680 case 1:
3681 STBIR_NO_UNROLL_LOOP_START
3682 do {
3683 STBIR_MOVE_1( pc, coeffs );
3684 ++pc;
3685 coeffs += coefficient_width;
3686 } while ( pc < pc_end );
3687 break;
3688 case 2:
3689 STBIR_NO_UNROLL_LOOP_START
3690 do {
3691 STBIR_MOVE_2( pc, coeffs );
3692 pc += 2;
3693 coeffs += coefficient_width;
3694 } while ( pc < pc_end );
3695 break;
3696 case 3:
3697 STBIR_NO_UNROLL_LOOP_START
3698 do {
3699 STBIR_MOVE_2( pc, coeffs );
3700 STBIR_MOVE_1( pc+2, coeffs+2 );
3701 pc += 3;
3702 coeffs += coefficient_width;
3703 } while ( pc < pc_end );
3704 break;
3705 case 4:
3706 STBIR_NO_UNROLL_LOOP_START
3707 do {
3708 STBIR_MOVE_4( pc, coeffs );
3709 pc += 4;
3710 coeffs += coefficient_width;
3711 } while ( pc < pc_end );
3712 break;
3713 case 5:
3714 STBIR_NO_UNROLL_LOOP_START
3715 do {
3716 STBIR_MOVE_4( pc, coeffs );
3717 STBIR_MOVE_1( pc+4, coeffs+4 );
3718 pc += 5;
3719 coeffs += coefficient_width;
3720 } while ( pc < pc_end );
3721 break;
3722 case 6:
3723 STBIR_NO_UNROLL_LOOP_START
3724 do {
3725 STBIR_MOVE_4( pc, coeffs );
3726 STBIR_MOVE_2( pc+4, coeffs+4 );
3727 pc += 6;
3728 coeffs += coefficient_width;
3729 } while ( pc < pc_end );
3730 break;
3731 case 7:
3732 STBIR_NO_UNROLL_LOOP_START
3733 do {
3734 STBIR_MOVE_4( pc, coeffs );
3735 STBIR_MOVE_2( pc+4, coeffs+4 );
3736 STBIR_MOVE_1( pc+6, coeffs+6 );
3737 pc += 7;
3738 coeffs += coefficient_width;
3739 } while ( pc < pc_end );
3740 break;
3741 case 8:
3742 STBIR_NO_UNROLL_LOOP_START
3743 do {
3744 STBIR_MOVE_4( pc, coeffs );
3745 STBIR_MOVE_4( pc+4, coeffs+4 );
3746 pc += 8;
3747 coeffs += coefficient_width;
3748 } while ( pc < pc_end );
3749 break;
3750 case 9:
3751 STBIR_NO_UNROLL_LOOP_START
3752 do {
3753 STBIR_MOVE_4( pc, coeffs );
3754 STBIR_MOVE_4( pc+4, coeffs+4 );
3755 STBIR_MOVE_1( pc+8, coeffs+8 );
3756 pc += 9;
3757 coeffs += coefficient_width;
3758 } while ( pc < pc_end );
3759 break;
3760 case 10:
3761 STBIR_NO_UNROLL_LOOP_START
3762 do {
3763 STBIR_MOVE_4( pc, coeffs );
3764 STBIR_MOVE_4( pc+4, coeffs+4 );
3765 STBIR_MOVE_2( pc+8, coeffs+8 );
3766 pc += 10;
3767 coeffs += coefficient_width;
3768 } while ( pc < pc_end );
3769 break;
3770 case 11:
3771 STBIR_NO_UNROLL_LOOP_START
3772 do {
3773 STBIR_MOVE_4( pc, coeffs );
3774 STBIR_MOVE_4( pc+4, coeffs+4 );
3775 STBIR_MOVE_2( pc+8, coeffs+8 );
3776 STBIR_MOVE_1( pc+10, coeffs+10 );
3777 pc += 11;
3778 coeffs += coefficient_width;
3779 } while ( pc < pc_end );
3780 break;
3781 case 12:
3782 STBIR_NO_UNROLL_LOOP_START
3783 do {
3784 STBIR_MOVE_4( pc, coeffs );
3785 STBIR_MOVE_4( pc+4, coeffs+4 );
3786 STBIR_MOVE_4( pc+8, coeffs+8 );
3787 pc += 12;
3788 coeffs += coefficient_width;
3789 } while ( pc < pc_end );
3790 break;
3791 default:
3792 STBIR_NO_UNROLL_LOOP_START
3793 do {
3794 float * copy_end = pc + widest - 4;
3795 float * c = coeffs;
3796 do {
3797 STBIR_NO_UNROLL( pc );
3798 STBIR_MOVE_4( pc, c );
3799 pc += 4;
3800 c += 4;
3801 } while ( pc <= copy_end );
3802 copy_end += 4;
3803 STBIR_NO_UNROLL_LOOP_START
3804 while ( pc < copy_end )
3805 {
3806 STBIR_MOVE_1( pc, c );
3807 ++pc; ++c;
3808 }
3809 coeffs += coefficient_width;
3810 } while ( pc < pc_end );
3811 break;
3812 }
3813 }
3814
3815 // some horizontal routines read one float off the end (which is then masked off), so put in a sentinal so we don't read an snan or denormal
3816 coefficents[ widest * num_contributors ] = 8888.0f;
3817
3818 // the minimum we might read for unrolled filters widths is 12. So, we need to
3819 // make sure we never read outside the decode buffer, by possibly moving
3820 // the sample area back into the scanline, and putting zeros weights first.
3821 // we start on the right edge and check until we're well past the possible
3822 // clip area (2*widest).
3823 {
3824 stbir__contributors * contribs = contributors + num_contributors - 1;
3825 float * coeffs = coefficents + widest * ( num_contributors - 1 );
3826
3827 // go until no chance of clipping (this is usually less than 8 lops)
3828 while ( ( contribs >= contributors ) && ( ( contribs->n0 + widest*2 ) >= row_end ) )
3829 {
3830 // might we clip??
3831 if ( ( contribs->n0 + widest ) > row_end )
3832 {
3833 int stop_range = widest;
3834
3835 // if range is larger than 12, it will be handled by generic loops that can terminate on the exact length
3836 // of this contrib n1, instead of a fixed widest amount - so calculate this
3837 if ( widest > 12 )
3838 {
3839 int mod;
3840
3841 // how far will be read in the n_coeff loop (which depends on the widest count mod4);
3842 mod = widest & 3;
3843 stop_range = ( ( ( contribs->n1 - contribs->n0 + 1 ) - mod + 3 ) & ~3 ) + mod;
3844
3845 // the n_coeff loops do a minimum amount of coeffs, so factor that in!
3846 if ( stop_range < ( 8 + mod ) ) stop_range = 8 + mod;
3847 }
3848
3849 // now see if we still clip with the refined range
3850 if ( ( contribs->n0 + stop_range ) > row_end )
3851 {
3852 int new_n0 = row_end - stop_range;
3853 int num = contribs->n1 - contribs->n0 + 1;
3854 int backup = contribs->n0 - new_n0;
3855 float * from_co = coeffs + num - 1;
3856 float * to_co = from_co + backup;
3857
3858 STBIR_ASSERT( ( new_n0 >= row0 ) && ( new_n0 < contribs->n0 ) );
3859
3860 // move the coeffs over
3861 while( num )
3862 {
3863 *to_co-- = *from_co--;
3864 --num;
3865 }
3866 // zero new positions
3867 while ( to_co >= coeffs )
3868 *to_co-- = 0;
3869 // set new start point
3870 contribs->n0 = new_n0;
3871 if ( widest > 12 )
3872 {
3873 int mod;
3874
3875 // how far will be read in the n_coeff loop (which depends on the widest count mod4);
3876 mod = widest & 3;
3877 stop_range = ( ( ( contribs->n1 - contribs->n0 + 1 ) - mod + 3 ) & ~3 ) + mod;
3878
3879 // the n_coeff loops do a minimum amount of coeffs, so factor that in!
3880 if ( stop_range < ( 8 + mod ) ) stop_range = 8 + mod;
3881 }
3882 }
3883 }
3884 --contribs;
3885 coeffs -= widest;
3886 }
3887 }
3888
3889 return widest;
3890 #undef STBIR_MOVE_1
3891 #undef STBIR_MOVE_2
3892 #undef STBIR_MOVE_4
3893}
3894
3895static void stbir__calculate_filters( stbir__sampler * samp, stbir__sampler * other_axis_for_pivot, void * user_data STBIR_ONLY_PROFILE_BUILD_GET_INFO )
3896{
3897 int n;
3898 float scale = samp->scale_info.scale;
3899 stbir__kernel_callback * kernel = samp->filter_kernel;
3900 stbir__support_callback * support = samp->filter_support;
3901 float inv_scale = samp->scale_info.inv_scale;
3902 int input_full_size = samp->scale_info.input_full_size;
3903 int gather_num_contributors = samp->num_contributors;
3904 stbir__contributors* gather_contributors = samp->contributors;
3905 float * gather_coeffs = samp->coefficients;
3906 int gather_coefficient_width = samp->coefficient_width;
3907
3908 switch ( samp->is_gather )
3909 {
3910 case 1: // gather upsample
3911 {
3912 float out_pixels_radius = support(inv_scale,user_data) * scale;
3913
3914 stbir__calculate_coefficients_for_gather_upsample( out_pixels_radius, kernel, &samp->scale_info, gather_num_contributors, gather_contributors, gather_coeffs, gather_coefficient_width, samp->edge, user_data );
3915
3916 STBIR_PROFILE_BUILD_START( cleanup );
3917 stbir__cleanup_gathered_coefficients( samp->edge, &samp->extent_info, &samp->scale_info, gather_num_contributors, gather_contributors, gather_coeffs, gather_coefficient_width );
3918 STBIR_PROFILE_BUILD_END( cleanup );
3919 }
3920 break;
3921
3922 case 0: // scatter downsample (only on vertical)
3923 case 2: // gather downsample
3924 {
3925 float in_pixels_radius = support(scale,user_data) * inv_scale;
3926 int filter_pixel_margin = samp->filter_pixel_margin;
3927 int input_end = input_full_size + filter_pixel_margin;
3928
3929 // if this is a scatter, we do a downsample gather to get the coeffs, and then pivot after
3930 if ( !samp->is_gather )
3931 {
3932 // check if we are using the same gather downsample on the horizontal as this vertical,
3933 // if so, then we don't have to generate them, we can just pivot from the horizontal.
3934 if ( other_axis_for_pivot )
3935 {
3936 gather_contributors = other_axis_for_pivot->contributors;
3937 gather_coeffs = other_axis_for_pivot->coefficients;
3938 gather_coefficient_width = other_axis_for_pivot->coefficient_width;
3939 gather_num_contributors = other_axis_for_pivot->num_contributors;
3940 samp->extent_info.lowest = other_axis_for_pivot->extent_info.lowest;
3941 samp->extent_info.highest = other_axis_for_pivot->extent_info.highest;
3942 samp->extent_info.widest = other_axis_for_pivot->extent_info.widest;
3943 goto jump_right_to_pivot;
3944 }
3945
3946 gather_contributors = samp->gather_prescatter_contributors;
3947 gather_coeffs = samp->gather_prescatter_coefficients;
3948 gather_coefficient_width = samp->gather_prescatter_coefficient_width;
3949 gather_num_contributors = samp->gather_prescatter_num_contributors;
3950 }
3951
3952 stbir__calculate_coefficients_for_gather_downsample( -filter_pixel_margin, input_end, in_pixels_radius, kernel, &samp->scale_info, gather_coefficient_width, gather_num_contributors, gather_contributors, gather_coeffs, user_data );
3953
3954 STBIR_PROFILE_BUILD_START( cleanup );
3955 stbir__cleanup_gathered_coefficients( samp->edge, &samp->extent_info, &samp->scale_info, gather_num_contributors, gather_contributors, gather_coeffs, gather_coefficient_width );
3956 STBIR_PROFILE_BUILD_END( cleanup );
3957
3958 if ( !samp->is_gather )
3959 {
3960 // if this is a scatter (vertical only), then we need to pivot the coeffs
3961 stbir__contributors * scatter_contributors;
3962 int highest_set;
3963
3964 jump_right_to_pivot:
3965
3966 STBIR_PROFILE_BUILD_START( pivot );
3967
3968 highest_set = (-filter_pixel_margin) - 1;
3969 for (n = 0; n < gather_num_contributors; n++)
3970 {
3971 int k;
3972 int gn0 = gather_contributors->n0, gn1 = gather_contributors->n1;
3973 int scatter_coefficient_width = samp->coefficient_width;
3974 float * scatter_coeffs = samp->coefficients + ( gn0 + filter_pixel_margin ) * scatter_coefficient_width;
3975 float * g_coeffs = gather_coeffs;
3976 scatter_contributors = samp->contributors + ( gn0 + filter_pixel_margin );
3977
3978 for (k = gn0 ; k <= gn1 ; k++ )
3979 {
3980 float gc = *g_coeffs++;
3981
3982 // skip zero and denormals - must skip zeros to avoid adding coeffs beyond scatter_coefficient_width
3983 // (which happens when pivoting from horizontal, which might have dummy zeros)
3984 if ( ( ( gc >= stbir__small_float ) || ( gc <= -stbir__small_float ) ) )
3985 {
3986 if ( ( k > highest_set ) || ( scatter_contributors->n0 > scatter_contributors->n1 ) )
3987 {
3988 {
3989 // if we are skipping over several contributors, we need to clear the skipped ones
3990 stbir__contributors * clear_contributors = samp->contributors + ( highest_set + filter_pixel_margin + 1);
3991 while ( clear_contributors < scatter_contributors )
3992 {
3993 clear_contributors->n0 = 0;
3994 clear_contributors->n1 = -1;
3995 ++clear_contributors;
3996 }
3997 }
3998 scatter_contributors->n0 = n;
3999 scatter_contributors->n1 = n;
4000 scatter_coeffs[0] = gc;
4001 highest_set = k;
4002 }
4003 else
4004 {
4005 stbir__insert_coeff( scatter_contributors, scatter_coeffs, n, gc, scatter_coefficient_width );
4006 }
4007 STBIR_ASSERT( ( scatter_contributors->n1 - scatter_contributors->n0 + 1 ) <= scatter_coefficient_width );
4008 }
4009 ++scatter_contributors;
4010 scatter_coeffs += scatter_coefficient_width;
4011 }
4012
4013 ++gather_contributors;
4014 gather_coeffs += gather_coefficient_width;
4015 }
4016
4017 // now clear any unset contribs
4018 {
4019 stbir__contributors * clear_contributors = samp->contributors + ( highest_set + filter_pixel_margin + 1);
4020 stbir__contributors * end_contributors = samp->contributors + samp->num_contributors;
4021 while ( clear_contributors < end_contributors )
4022 {
4023 clear_contributors->n0 = 0;
4024 clear_contributors->n1 = -1;
4025 ++clear_contributors;
4026 }
4027 }
4028
4029 STBIR_PROFILE_BUILD_END( pivot );
4030 }
4031 }
4032 break;
4033 }
4034}

4101// fancy alpha means we expand to keep both premultipied and non-premultiplied color channels
4102static void stbir__fancy_alpha_weight_4ch( float * out_buffer, int width_times_channels )
4103{
4104 float STBIR_STREAMOUT_PTR(*) out = out_buffer;
4105 float const * end_decode = out_buffer + ( width_times_channels / 4 ) * 7; // decode buffer aligned to end of out_buffer
4106 float STBIR_STREAMOUT_PTR(*) decode = (float*)end_decode - width_times_channels;
4107
4108 // fancy alpha is stored internally as R G B A Rpm Gpm Bpm
4109
4110 #ifdef STBIR_SIMD
4111
4112 #ifdef STBIR_SIMD8
4113 decode += 16;
4114 STBIR_NO_UNROLL_LOOP_START
4115 while ( decode <= end_decode )
4116 {
4117 stbir__simdf8 d0,d1,a0,a1,p0,p1;
4118 STBIR_NO_UNROLL(decode);
4119 stbir__simdf8_load( d0, decode-16 );
4120 stbir__simdf8_load( d1, decode-16+8 );
4121 stbir__simdf8_0123to33333333( a0, d0 );
4122 stbir__simdf8_0123to33333333( a1, d1 );
4123 stbir__simdf8_mult( p0, a0, d0 );
4124 stbir__simdf8_mult( p1, a1, d1 );
4125 stbir__simdf8_bot4s( a0, d0, p0 );
4126 stbir__simdf8_bot4s( a1, d1, p1 );
4127 stbir__simdf8_top4s( d0, d0, p0 );
4128 stbir__simdf8_top4s( d1, d1, p1 );
4129 stbir__simdf8_store ( out, a0 );
4130 stbir__simdf8_store ( out+7, d0 );
4131 stbir__simdf8_store ( out+14, a1 );
4132 stbir__simdf8_store ( out+21, d1 );
4133 decode += 16;
4134 out += 28;
4135 }
4136 decode -= 16;
4137 #else
4138 decode += 8;
4139 STBIR_NO_UNROLL_LOOP_START
4140 while ( decode <= end_decode )
4141 {
4142 stbir__simdf d0,a0,d1,a1,p0,p1;
4143 STBIR_NO_UNROLL(decode);
4144 stbir__simdf_load( d0, decode-8 );
4145 stbir__simdf_load( d1, decode-8+4 );
4146 stbir__simdf_0123to3333( a0, d0 );
4147 stbir__simdf_0123to3333( a1, d1 );
4148 stbir__simdf_mult( p0, a0, d0 );
4149 stbir__simdf_mult( p1, a1, d1 );
4150 stbir__simdf_store ( out, d0 );
4151 stbir__simdf_store ( out+4, p0 );
4152 stbir__simdf_store ( out+7, d1 );
4153 stbir__simdf_store ( out+7+4, p1 );
4154 decode += 8;
4155 out += 14;
4156 }
4157 decode -= 8;
4158 #endif
4159
4160 // might be one last odd pixel
4161 #ifdef STBIR_SIMD8
4162 STBIR_NO_UNROLL_LOOP_START
4163 while ( decode < end_decode )
4164 #else
4165 if ( decode < end_decode )
4166 #endif
4167 {
4168 stbir__simdf d,a,p;
4169 STBIR_NO_UNROLL(decode);
4170 stbir__simdf_load( d, decode );
4171 stbir__simdf_0123to3333( a, d );
4172 stbir__simdf_mult( p, a, d );
4173 stbir__simdf_store ( out, d );
4174 stbir__simdf_store ( out+4, p );
4175 decode += 4;
4176 out += 7;
4177 }
4178
4179 #else
4180
4181 while( decode < end_decode )
4182 {
4183 float r = decode[0], g = decode[1], b = decode[2], alpha = decode[3];
4184 out[0] = r;
4185 out[1] = g;
4186 out[2] = b;
4187 out[3] = alpha;
4188 out[4] = r * alpha;
4189 out[5] = g * alpha;
4190 out[6] = b * alpha;
4191 out += 7;
4192 decode += 4;
4193 }
4194
4195 #endif
4196}
4197
4198static void stbir__fancy_alpha_weight_2ch( float * out_buffer, int width_times_channels )
4199{
4200 float STBIR_STREAMOUT_PTR(*) out = out_buffer;
4201 float const * end_decode = out_buffer + ( width_times_channels / 2 ) * 3;
4202 float STBIR_STREAMOUT_PTR(*) decode = (float*)end_decode - width_times_channels;
4203
4204 // for fancy alpha, turns into: [X A Xpm][X A Xpm],etc
4205
4206 #ifdef STBIR_SIMD
4207
4208 decode += 8;
4209 if ( decode <= end_decode )
4210 {
4211 STBIR_NO_UNROLL_LOOP_START
4212 do {
4213 #ifdef STBIR_SIMD8
4214 stbir__simdf8 d0,a0,p0;
4215 STBIR_NO_UNROLL(decode);
4216 stbir__simdf8_load( d0, decode-8 );
4217 stbir__simdf8_0123to11331133( p0, d0 );
4218 stbir__simdf8_0123to00220022( a0, d0 );
4219 stbir__simdf8_mult( p0, p0, a0 );
4220
4221 stbir__simdf_store2( out, stbir__if_simdf8_cast_to_simdf4( d0 ) );
4222 stbir__simdf_store( out+2, stbir__if_simdf8_cast_to_simdf4( p0 ) );
4223 stbir__simdf_store2h( out+3, stbir__if_simdf8_cast_to_simdf4( d0 ) );
4224
4225 stbir__simdf_store2( out+6, stbir__simdf8_gettop4( d0 ) );
4226 stbir__simdf_store( out+8, stbir__simdf8_gettop4( p0 ) );
4227 stbir__simdf_store2h( out+9, stbir__simdf8_gettop4( d0 ) );
4228 #else
4229 stbir__simdf d0,a0,d1,a1,p0,p1;
4230 STBIR_NO_UNROLL(decode);
4231 stbir__simdf_load( d0, decode-8 );
4232 stbir__simdf_load( d1, decode-8+4 );
4233 stbir__simdf_0123to1133( p0, d0 );
4234 stbir__simdf_0123to1133( p1, d1 );
4235 stbir__simdf_0123to0022( a0, d0 );
4236 stbir__simdf_0123to0022( a1, d1 );
4237 stbir__simdf_mult( p0, p0, a0 );
4238 stbir__simdf_mult( p1, p1, a1 );
4239
4240 stbir__simdf_store2( out, d0 );
4241 stbir__simdf_store( out+2, p0 );
4242 stbir__simdf_store2h( out+3, d0 );
4243
4244 stbir__simdf_store2( out+6, d1 );
4245 stbir__simdf_store( out+8, p1 );
4246 stbir__simdf_store2h( out+9, d1 );
4247 #endif
4248 decode += 8;
4249 out += 12;
4250 } while ( decode <= end_decode );
4251 }
4252 decode -= 8;
4253 #endif
4254
4255 STBIR_SIMD_NO_UNROLL_LOOP_START
4256 while( decode < end_decode )
4257 {
4258 float x = decode[0], y = decode[1];
4259 STBIR_SIMD_NO_UNROLL(decode);
4260 out[0] = x;
4261 out[1] = y;
4262 out[2] = x * y;
4263 out += 3;
4264 decode += 2;
4265 }
4266}
4267
4268static void stbir__fancy_alpha_unweight_4ch( float * encode_buffer, int width_times_channels )
4269{
4270 float STBIR_SIMD_STREAMOUT_PTR(*) encode = encode_buffer;
4271 float STBIR_SIMD_STREAMOUT_PTR(*) input = encode_buffer;
4272 float const * end_output = encode_buffer + width_times_channels;
4273
4274 // fancy RGBA is stored internally as R G B A Rpm Gpm Bpm
4275
4276 STBIR_SIMD_NO_UNROLL_LOOP_START
4277 do {
4278 float alpha = input[3];
4279#ifdef STBIR_SIMD
4280 stbir__simdf i,ia;
4281 STBIR_SIMD_NO_UNROLL(encode);
4282 if ( alpha < stbir__small_float )
4283 {
4284 stbir__simdf_load( i, input );
4285 stbir__simdf_store( encode, i );
4286 }
4287 else
4288 {
4289 stbir__simdf_load1frep4( ia, 1.0f / alpha );
4290 stbir__simdf_load( i, input+4 );
4291 stbir__simdf_mult( i, i, ia );
4292 stbir__simdf_store( encode, i );
4293 encode[3] = alpha;
4294 }
4295#else
4296 if ( alpha < stbir__small_float )
4297 {
4298 encode[0] = input[0];
4299 encode[1] = input[1];
4300 encode[2] = input[2];
4301 }
4302 else
4303 {
4304 float ialpha = 1.0f / alpha;
4305 encode[0] = input[4] * ialpha;
4306 encode[1] = input[5] * ialpha;
4307 encode[2] = input[6] * ialpha;
4308 }
4309 encode[3] = alpha;
4310#endif
4311
4312 input += 7;
4313 encode += 4;
4314 } while ( encode < end_output );
4315}
4316
4317// format: [X A Xpm][X A Xpm] etc
4318static void stbir__fancy_alpha_unweight_2ch( float * encode_buffer, int width_times_channels )
4319{
4320 float STBIR_SIMD_STREAMOUT_PTR(*) encode = encode_buffer;
4321 float STBIR_SIMD_STREAMOUT_PTR(*) input = encode_buffer;
4322 float const * end_output = encode_buffer + width_times_channels;
4323
4324 do {
4325 float alpha = input[1];
4326 encode[0] = input[0];
4327 if ( alpha >= stbir__small_float )
4328 encode[0] = input[2] / alpha;
4329 encode[1] = alpha;
4330
4331 input += 3;
4332 encode += 2;
4333 } while ( encode < end_output );
4334}
4335
4336static void stbir__simple_alpha_weight_4ch( float * decode_buffer, int width_times_channels )
4337{
4338 float STBIR_STREAMOUT_PTR(*) decode = decode_buffer;
4339 float const * end_decode = decode_buffer + width_times_channels;
4340
4341 #ifdef STBIR_SIMD
4342 {
4343 decode += 2 * stbir__simdfX_float_count;
4344 STBIR_NO_UNROLL_LOOP_START
4345 while ( decode <= end_decode )
4346 {
4347 stbir__simdfX d0,a0,d1,a1;
4348 STBIR_NO_UNROLL(decode);
4349 stbir__simdfX_load( d0, decode-2*stbir__simdfX_float_count );
4350 stbir__simdfX_load( d1, decode-2*stbir__simdfX_float_count+stbir__simdfX_float_count );
4351 stbir__simdfX_aaa1( a0, d0, STBIR_onesX );
4352 stbir__simdfX_aaa1( a1, d1, STBIR_onesX );
4353 stbir__simdfX_mult( d0, d0, a0 );
4354 stbir__simdfX_mult( d1, d1, a1 );
4355 stbir__simdfX_store ( decode-2*stbir__simdfX_float_count, d0 );
4356 stbir__simdfX_store ( decode-2*stbir__simdfX_float_count+stbir__simdfX_float_count, d1 );
4357 decode += 2 * stbir__simdfX_float_count;
4358 }
4359 decode -= 2 * stbir__simdfX_float_count;
4360
4361 // few last pixels remnants
4362 #ifdef STBIR_SIMD8
4363 STBIR_NO_UNROLL_LOOP_START
4364 while ( decode < end_decode )
4365 #else
4366 if ( decode < end_decode )
4367 #endif
4368 {
4369 stbir__simdf d,a;
4370 stbir__simdf_load( d, decode );
4371 stbir__simdf_aaa1( a, d, STBIR__CONSTF(STBIR_ones) );
4372 stbir__simdf_mult( d, d, a );
4373 stbir__simdf_store ( decode, d );
4374 decode += 4;
4375 }
4376 }
4377
4378 #else
4379
4380 while( decode < end_decode )
4381 {
4382 float alpha = decode[3];
4383 decode[0] *= alpha;
4384 decode[1] *= alpha;
4385 decode[2] *= alpha;
4386 decode += 4;
4387 }
4388
4389 #endif
4390}
4391
4392static void stbir__simple_alpha_weight_2ch( float * decode_buffer, int width_times_channels )
4393{
4394 float STBIR_STREAMOUT_PTR(*) decode = decode_buffer;
4395 float const * end_decode = decode_buffer + width_times_channels;
4396
4397 #ifdef STBIR_SIMD
4398 decode += 2 * stbir__simdfX_float_count;
4399 STBIR_NO_UNROLL_LOOP_START
4400 while ( decode <= end_decode )
4401 {
4402 stbir__simdfX d0,a0,d1,a1;
4403 STBIR_NO_UNROLL(decode);
4404 stbir__simdfX_load( d0, decode-2*stbir__simdfX_float_count );
4405 stbir__simdfX_load( d1, decode-2*stbir__simdfX_float_count+stbir__simdfX_float_count );
4406 stbir__simdfX_a1a1( a0, d0, STBIR_onesX );
4407 stbir__simdfX_a1a1( a1, d1, STBIR_onesX );
4408 stbir__simdfX_mult( d0, d0, a0 );
4409 stbir__simdfX_mult( d1, d1, a1 );
4410 stbir__simdfX_store ( decode-2*stbir__simdfX_float_count, d0 );
4411 stbir__simdfX_store ( decode-2*stbir__simdfX_float_count+stbir__simdfX_float_count, d1 );
4412 decode += 2 * stbir__simdfX_float_count;
4413 }
4414 decode -= 2 * stbir__simdfX_float_count;
4415 #endif
4416
4417 STBIR_SIMD_NO_UNROLL_LOOP_START
4418 while( decode < end_decode )
4419 {
4420 float alpha = decode[1];
4421 STBIR_SIMD_NO_UNROLL(decode);
4422 decode[0] *= alpha;
4423 decode += 2;
4424 }
4425}
4426
4427static void stbir__simple_alpha_unweight_4ch( float * encode_buffer, int width_times_channels )
4428{
4429 float STBIR_SIMD_STREAMOUT_PTR(*) encode = encode_buffer;
4430 float const * end_output = encode_buffer + width_times_channels;
4431
4432 STBIR_SIMD_NO_UNROLL_LOOP_START
4433 do {
4434 float alpha = encode[3];
4435
4436#ifdef STBIR_SIMD
4437 stbir__simdf i,ia;
4438 STBIR_SIMD_NO_UNROLL(encode);
4439 if ( alpha >= stbir__small_float )
4440 {
4441 stbir__simdf_load1frep4( ia, 1.0f / alpha );
4442 stbir__simdf_load( i, encode );
4443 stbir__simdf_mult( i, i, ia );
4444 stbir__simdf_store( encode, i );
4445 encode[3] = alpha;
4446 }
4447#else
4448 if ( alpha >= stbir__small_float )
4449 {
4450 float ialpha = 1.0f / alpha;
4451 encode[0] *= ialpha;
4452 encode[1] *= ialpha;
4453 encode[2] *= ialpha;
4454 }
4455#endif
4456 encode += 4;
4457 } while ( encode < end_output );
4458}
4459
4460static void stbir__simple_alpha_unweight_2ch( float * encode_buffer, int width_times_channels )
4461{
4462 float STBIR_SIMD_STREAMOUT_PTR(*) encode = encode_buffer;
4463 float const * end_output = encode_buffer + width_times_channels;
4464
4465 do {
4466 float alpha = encode[1];
4467 if ( alpha >= stbir__small_float )
4468 encode[0] /= alpha;
4469 encode += 2;
4470 } while ( encode < end_output );
4471}

4474// only used in RGB->BGR or BGR->RGB
4475static void stbir__simple_flip_3ch( float * decode_buffer, int width_times_channels )
4476{
4477 float STBIR_STREAMOUT_PTR(*) decode = decode_buffer;
4478 float const * end_decode = decode_buffer + width_times_channels;
4479
4480#ifdef STBIR_SIMD
4481 #ifdef stbir__simdf_swiz2 // do we have two argument swizzles?
4482 end_decode -= 12;
4483 STBIR_NO_UNROLL_LOOP_START
4484 while( decode <= end_decode )
4485 {
4486 // on arm64 8 instructions, no overlapping stores
4487 stbir__simdf a,b,c,na,nb;
4488 STBIR_SIMD_NO_UNROLL(decode);
4489 stbir__simdf_load( a, decode );
4490 stbir__simdf_load( b, decode+4 );
4491 stbir__simdf_load( c, decode+8 );
4492
4493 na = stbir__simdf_swiz2( a, b, 2, 1, 0, 5 );
4494 b = stbir__simdf_swiz2( a, b, 4, 3, 6, 7 );
4495 nb = stbir__simdf_swiz2( b, c, 0, 1, 4, 3 );
4496 c = stbir__simdf_swiz2( b, c, 2, 7, 6, 5 );
4497
4498 stbir__simdf_store( decode, na );
4499 stbir__simdf_store( decode+4, nb );
4500 stbir__simdf_store( decode+8, c );
4501 decode += 12;
4502 }
4503 end_decode += 12;
4504 #else
4505 end_decode -= 24;
4506 STBIR_NO_UNROLL_LOOP_START
4507 while( decode <= end_decode )
4508 {
4509 // 26 instructions on x64
4510 stbir__simdf a,b,c,d,e,f,g;
4511 float i21, i23;
4512 STBIR_SIMD_NO_UNROLL(decode);
4513 stbir__simdf_load( a, decode );
4514 stbir__simdf_load( b, decode+3 );
4515 stbir__simdf_load( c, decode+6 );
4516 stbir__simdf_load( d, decode+9 );
4517 stbir__simdf_load( e, decode+12 );
4518 stbir__simdf_load( f, decode+15 );
4519 stbir__simdf_load( g, decode+18 );
4520
4521 a = stbir__simdf_swiz( a, 2, 1, 0, 3 );
4522 b = stbir__simdf_swiz( b, 2, 1, 0, 3 );
4523 c = stbir__simdf_swiz( c, 2, 1, 0, 3 );
4524 d = stbir__simdf_swiz( d, 2, 1, 0, 3 );
4525 e = stbir__simdf_swiz( e, 2, 1, 0, 3 );
4526 f = stbir__simdf_swiz( f, 2, 1, 0, 3 );
4527 g = stbir__simdf_swiz( g, 2, 1, 0, 3 );
4528
4529 // stores overlap, need to be in order,
4530 stbir__simdf_store( decode, a );
4531 i21 = decode[21];
4532 stbir__simdf_store( decode+3, b );
4533 i23 = decode[23];
4534 stbir__simdf_store( decode+6, c );
4535 stbir__simdf_store( decode+9, d );
4536 stbir__simdf_store( decode+12, e );
4537 stbir__simdf_store( decode+15, f );
4538 stbir__simdf_store( decode+18, g );
4539 decode[21] = i23;
4540 decode[23] = i21;
4541 decode += 24;
4542 }
4543 end_decode += 24;
4544 #endif
4545#else
4546 end_decode -= 12;
4547 STBIR_NO_UNROLL_LOOP_START
4548 while( decode <= end_decode )
4549 {
4550 // 16 instructions
4551 float t0,t1,t2,t3;
4552 STBIR_NO_UNROLL(decode);
4553 t0 = decode[0]; t1 = decode[3]; t2 = decode[6]; t3 = decode[9];
4554 decode[0] = decode[2]; decode[3] = decode[5]; decode[6] = decode[8]; decode[9] = decode[11];
4555 decode[2] = t0; decode[5] = t1; decode[8] = t2; decode[11] = t3;
4556 decode += 12;
4557 }
4558 end_decode += 12;
4559#endif
4560
4561 STBIR_NO_UNROLL_LOOP_START
4562 while( decode < end_decode )
4563 {
4564 float t = decode[0];
4565 STBIR_NO_UNROLL(decode);
4566 decode[0] = decode[2];
4567 decode[2] = t;
4568 decode += 3;
4569 }
4570}

4573
4574static void stbir__decode_scanline(stbir__info const * stbir_info, int n, float * output_buffer STBIR_ONLY_PROFILE_GET_SPLIT_INFO )
4575{
4576 int channels = stbir_info->channels;
4577 int effective_channels = stbir_info->effective_channels;
4578 int input_sample_in_bytes = stbir__type_size[stbir_info->input_type] * channels;
4579 stbir_edge edge_horizontal = stbir_info->horizontal.edge;
4580 stbir_edge edge_vertical = stbir_info->vertical.edge;
4581 int row = stbir__edge_wrap(edge_vertical, n, stbir_info->vertical.scale_info.input_full_size);
4582 const void* input_plane_data = ( (char *) stbir_info->input_data ) + (size_t)row * (size_t) stbir_info->input_stride_bytes;
4583 stbir__span const * spans = stbir_info->scanline_extents.spans;
4584 float * full_decode_buffer = output_buffer - stbir_info->scanline_extents.conservative.n0 * effective_channels;
4585 float * last_decoded = 0;
4586
4587 // if we are on edge_zero, and we get in here with an out of bounds n, then the calculate filters has failed
4588 STBIR_ASSERT( !(edge_vertical == STBIR_EDGE_ZERO && (n < 0 || n >= stbir_info->vertical.scale_info.input_full_size)) );
4589
4590 do
4591 {
4592 float * decode_buffer;
4593 void const * input_data;
4594 float * end_decode;
4595 int width_times_channels;
4596 int width;
4597
4598 if ( spans->n1 < spans->n0 )
4599 break;
4600
4601 width = spans->n1 + 1 - spans->n0;
4602 decode_buffer = full_decode_buffer + spans->n0 * effective_channels;
4603 end_decode = full_decode_buffer + ( spans->n1 + 1 ) * effective_channels;
4604 width_times_channels = width * channels;
4605
4606 // read directly out of input plane by default
4607 input_data = ( (char*)input_plane_data ) + spans->pixel_offset_for_input * input_sample_in_bytes;
4608
4609 // if we have an input callback, call it to get the input data
4610 if ( stbir_info->in_pixels_cb )
4611 {
4612 // call the callback with a temp buffer (that they can choose to use or not). the temp is just right aligned memory in the decode_buffer itself
4613 input_data = stbir_info->in_pixels_cb( ( (char*) end_decode ) - ( width * input_sample_in_bytes ) + sizeof(float)*STBIR_INPUT_CALLBACK_PADDING, input_plane_data, width, spans->pixel_offset_for_input, row, stbir_info->user_data );
4614 }
4615
4616 STBIR_PROFILE_START( decode );
4617 // convert the pixels info the float decode_buffer, (we index from end_decode, so that when channels<effective_channels, we are right justified in the buffer)
4618 last_decoded = stbir_info->decode_pixels( (float*)end_decode - width_times_channels, width_times_channels, input_data );
4619 STBIR_PROFILE_END( decode );
4620
4621 if (stbir_info->alpha_weight)
4622 {
4623 STBIR_PROFILE_START( alpha );
4624 stbir_info->alpha_weight( decode_buffer, width_times_channels );
4625 STBIR_PROFILE_END( alpha );
4626 }
4627
4628 ++spans;
4629 } while ( spans <= ( &stbir_info->scanline_extents.spans[1] ) );
4630
4631 // handle the edge_wrap filter (all other types are handled back out at the calculate_filter stage)
4632 // basically the idea here is that if we have the whole scanline in memory, we don't redecode the
4633 // wrapped edge pixels, and instead just memcpy them from the scanline into the edge positions
4634 if ( ( edge_horizontal == STBIR_EDGE_WRAP ) && ( stbir_info->scanline_extents.edge_sizes[0] | stbir_info->scanline_extents.edge_sizes[1] ) )
4635 {
4636 // this code only runs if we're in edge_wrap, and we're doing the entire scanline
4637 int e, start_x[2];
4638 int input_full_size = stbir_info->horizontal.scale_info.input_full_size;
4639
4640 start_x[0] = -stbir_info->scanline_extents.edge_sizes[0]; // left edge start x
4641 start_x[1] = input_full_size; // right edge
4642
4643 for( e = 0; e < 2 ; e++ )
4644 {
4645 // do each margin
4646 int margin = stbir_info->scanline_extents.edge_sizes[e];
4647 if ( margin )
4648 {
4649 int x = start_x[e];
4650 float * marg = full_decode_buffer + x * effective_channels;
4651 float const * src = full_decode_buffer + stbir__edge_wrap(edge_horizontal, x, input_full_size) * effective_channels;
4652 STBIR_MEMCPY( marg, src, margin * effective_channels * sizeof(float) );
4653 if ( e == 1 ) last_decoded = marg + margin * effective_channels;
4654 }
4655 }
4656 }
4657
4658 // some of the horizontal gathers read one float off the edge (which is masked out), but we force a zero here to make sure no NaNs leak in
4659 // (we can't pre-zero it, because the input callback can use that area as padding)
4660 last_decoded[0] = 0.0f;
4661
4662 // we clear this extra float, because the final output pixel filter kernel might have used one less coeff than the max filter width
4663 // when this happens, we do read that pixel from the input, so it too could be Nan, so just zero an extra one.
4664 // this fits because each scanline is padded by three floats (STBIR_INPUT_CALLBACK_PADDING)
4665 last_decoded[1] = 0.0f;
4666}
4667
4668
4669//=================
4670// Do 1 channel horizontal routines
4671
4672#ifdef STBIR_SIMD
4673
4674#define stbir__1_coeff_only() \
4675 stbir__simdf tot,c; \
4676 STBIR_SIMD_NO_UNROLL(decode); \
4677 stbir__simdf_load1( c, hc ); \
4678 stbir__simdf_mult1_mem( tot, c, decode );
4679
4680#define stbir__2_coeff_only() \
4681 stbir__simdf tot,c,d; \
4682 STBIR_SIMD_NO_UNROLL(decode); \
4683 stbir__simdf_load2z( c, hc ); \
4684 stbir__simdf_load2( d, decode ); \
4685 stbir__simdf_mult( tot, c, d ); \
4686 stbir__simdf_0123to1230( c, tot ); \
4687 stbir__simdf_add1( tot, tot, c );
4688
4689#define stbir__3_coeff_only() \
4690 stbir__simdf tot,c,t; \
4691 STBIR_SIMD_NO_UNROLL(decode); \
4692 stbir__simdf_load( c, hc ); \
4693 stbir__simdf_mult_mem( tot, c, decode ); \
4694 stbir__simdf_0123to1230( c, tot ); \
4695 stbir__simdf_0123to2301( t, tot ); \
4696 stbir__simdf_add1( tot, tot, c ); \
4697 stbir__simdf_add1( tot, tot, t );
4698
4699#define stbir__store_output_tiny() \
4700 stbir__simdf_store1( output, tot ); \
4701 horizontal_coefficients += coefficient_width; \
4702 ++horizontal_contributors; \
4703 output += 1;
4704
4705#define stbir__4_coeff_start() \
4706 stbir__simdf tot,c; \
4707 STBIR_SIMD_NO_UNROLL(decode); \
4708 stbir__simdf_load( c, hc ); \
4709 stbir__simdf_mult_mem( tot, c, decode ); \
4710
4711#define stbir__4_coeff_continue_from_4( ofs ) \
4712 STBIR_SIMD_NO_UNROLL(decode); \
4713 stbir__simdf_load( c, hc + (ofs) ); \
4714 stbir__simdf_madd_mem( tot, tot, c, decode+(ofs) );
4715
4716#define stbir__1_coeff_remnant( ofs ) \
4717 { stbir__simdf d; \
4718 stbir__simdf_load1z( c, hc + (ofs) ); \
4719 stbir__simdf_load1( d, decode + (ofs) ); \
4720 stbir__simdf_madd( tot, tot, d, c ); }
4721
4722#define stbir__2_coeff_remnant( ofs ) \
4723 { stbir__simdf d; \
4724 stbir__simdf_load2z( c, hc+(ofs) ); \
4725 stbir__simdf_load2( d, decode+(ofs) ); \
4726 stbir__simdf_madd( tot, tot, d, c ); }
4727
4728#define stbir__3_coeff_setup() \
4729 stbir__simdf mask; \
4730 stbir__simdf_load( mask, STBIR_mask + 3 );
4731
4732#define stbir__3_coeff_remnant( ofs ) \
4733 stbir__simdf_load( c, hc+(ofs) ); \
4734 stbir__simdf_and( c, c, mask ); \
4735 stbir__simdf_madd_mem( tot, tot, c, decode+(ofs) );
4736
4737#define stbir__store_output() \
4738 stbir__simdf_0123to2301( c, tot ); \
4739 stbir__simdf_add( tot, tot, c ); \
4740 stbir__simdf_0123to1230( c, tot ); \
4741 stbir__simdf_add1( tot, tot, c ); \
4742 stbir__simdf_store1( output, tot ); \
4743 horizontal_coefficients += coefficient_width; \
4744 ++horizontal_contributors; \
4745 output += 1;
4746
4747#else
4748
4749#define stbir__1_coeff_only() \
4750 float tot; \
4751 tot = decode[0]*hc[0];
4752
4753#define stbir__2_coeff_only() \
4754 float tot; \
4755 tot = decode[0] * hc[0]; \
4756 tot += decode[1] * hc[1];
4757
4758#define stbir__3_coeff_only() \
4759 float tot; \
4760 tot = decode[0] * hc[0]; \
4761 tot += decode[1] * hc[1]; \
4762 tot += decode[2] * hc[2];
4763
4764#define stbir__store_output_tiny() \
4765 output[0] = tot; \
4766 horizontal_coefficients += coefficient_width; \
4767 ++horizontal_contributors; \
4768 output += 1;
4769
4770#define stbir__4_coeff_start() \
4771 float tot0,tot1,tot2,tot3; \
4772 tot0 = decode[0] * hc[0]; \
4773 tot1 = decode[1] * hc[1]; \
4774 tot2 = decode[2] * hc[2]; \
4775 tot3 = decode[3] * hc[3];
4776
4777#define stbir__4_coeff_continue_from_4( ofs ) \
4778 tot0 += decode[0+(ofs)] * hc[0+(ofs)]; \
4779 tot1 += decode[1+(ofs)] * hc[1+(ofs)]; \
4780 tot2 += decode[2+(ofs)] * hc[2+(ofs)]; \
4781 tot3 += decode[3+(ofs)] * hc[3+(ofs)];
4782
4783#define stbir__1_coeff_remnant( ofs ) \
4784 tot0 += decode[0+(ofs)] * hc[0+(ofs)];
4785
4786#define stbir__2_coeff_remnant( ofs ) \
4787 tot0 += decode[0+(ofs)] * hc[0+(ofs)]; \
4788 tot1 += decode[1+(ofs)] * hc[1+(ofs)]; \
4789
4790#define stbir__3_coeff_remnant( ofs ) \
4791 tot0 += decode[0+(ofs)] * hc[0+(ofs)]; \
4792 tot1 += decode[1+(ofs)] * hc[1+(ofs)]; \
4793 tot2 += decode[2+(ofs)] * hc[2+(ofs)];
4794
4795#define stbir__store_output() \
4796 output[0] = (tot0+tot2)+(tot1+tot3); \
4797 horizontal_coefficients += coefficient_width; \
4798 ++horizontal_contributors; \
4799 output += 1;
4800
4801#endif

4809// Do 2 channel horizontal routines
4810
4811#ifdef STBIR_SIMD
4812
4813#define stbir__1_coeff_only() \
4814 stbir__simdf tot,c,d; \
4815 STBIR_SIMD_NO_UNROLL(decode); \
4816 stbir__simdf_load1z( c, hc ); \
4817 stbir__simdf_0123to0011( c, c ); \
4818 stbir__simdf_load2( d, decode ); \
4819 stbir__simdf_mult( tot, d, c );
4820
4821#define stbir__2_coeff_only() \
4822 stbir__simdf tot,c; \

4824 stbir__simdf_load2( c, hc ); \
4825 stbir__simdf_0123to0011( c, c ); \
4826 stbir__simdf_mult_mem( tot, c, decode );
4827
4828#define stbir__3_coeff_only() \
4829 stbir__simdf tot,c,cs,d; \
4830 STBIR_SIMD_NO_UNROLL(decode); \
4831 stbir__simdf_load( cs, hc ); \
4832 stbir__simdf_0123to0011( c, cs ); \
4833 stbir__simdf_mult_mem( tot, c, decode ); \
4834 stbir__simdf_0123to2222( c, cs ); \
4835 stbir__simdf_load2z( d, decode+4 ); \
4836 stbir__simdf_madd( tot, tot, d, c );
4837
4838#define stbir__store_output_tiny() \
4839 stbir__simdf_0123to2301( c, tot ); \
4840 stbir__simdf_add( tot, tot, c ); \
4841 stbir__simdf_store2( output, tot ); \
4842 horizontal_coefficients += coefficient_width; \
4843 ++horizontal_contributors; \
4844 output += 2;
4845
4846#ifdef STBIR_SIMD8
4847
4848#define stbir__4_coeff_start() \
4849 stbir__simdf8 tot0,c,cs; \
4850 STBIR_SIMD_NO_UNROLL(decode); \

6148static void stbir__encode_scanline( stbir__info const * stbir_info, void *output_buffer_data, float * encode_buffer, int row STBIR_ONLY_PROFILE_GET_SPLIT_INFO )
6149{
6150 int num_pixels = stbir_info->horizontal.scale_info.output_sub_size;
6151 int channels = stbir_info->channels;
6152 int width_times_channels = num_pixels * channels;
6153 void * output_buffer;
6154
6155 // un-alpha weight if we need to
6156 if ( stbir_info->alpha_unweight )
6157 {
6158 STBIR_PROFILE_START( unalpha );
6159 stbir_info->alpha_unweight( encode_buffer, width_times_channels );
6160 STBIR_PROFILE_END( unalpha );
6161 }
6162
6163 // write directly into output by default
6164 output_buffer = output_buffer_data;
6165
6166 // if we have an output callback, we first convert the decode buffer in place (and then hand that to the callback)
6167 if ( stbir_info->out_pixels_cb )
6168 output_buffer = encode_buffer;
6169
6170 STBIR_PROFILE_START( encode );
6171 // convert into the output buffer
6172 stbir_info->encode_pixels( output_buffer, width_times_channels, encode_buffer );
6173 STBIR_PROFILE_END( encode );
6174
6175 // if we have an output callback, call it to send the data
6176 if ( stbir_info->out_pixels_cb )
6177 stbir_info->out_pixels_cb( output_buffer, num_pixels, row, stbir_info->user_data );
6178}
