6181// Get the ring buffer pointer for an index
6182static float* stbir__get_ring_buffer_entry(stbir__info const * stbir_info, stbir__per_split_info const * split_info, int index )
6183{
6184 STBIR_ASSERT( index < stbir_info->ring_buffer_num_entries );
6185
6186 #ifdef STBIR__SEPARATE_ALLOCATIONS
6187 return split_info->ring_buffers[ index ];
6188 #else
6189 return (float*) ( ( (char*) split_info->ring_buffer ) + ( index * stbir_info->ring_buffer_length_bytes ) );
6190 #endif
6191}
6192
6193// Get the specified scan line from the ring buffer
6194static float* stbir__get_ring_buffer_scanline(stbir__info const * stbir_info, stbir__per_split_info const * split_info, int get_scanline)
6195{
6196 int ring_buffer_index = (split_info->ring_buffer_begin_index + (get_scanline - split_info->ring_buffer_first_scanline)) % stbir_info->ring_buffer_num_entries;
6197 return stbir__get_ring_buffer_entry( stbir_info, split_info, ring_buffer_index );
6198}
6199
6200static void stbir__resample_horizontal_gather(stbir__info const * stbir_info, float* output_buffer, float const * input_buffer STBIR_ONLY_PROFILE_GET_SPLIT_INFO )
6201{
6202 float const * decode_buffer = input_buffer - ( stbir_info->scanline_extents.conservative.n0 * stbir_info->effective_channels );
6203
6204 STBIR_PROFILE_START( horizontal );
6205 if ( ( stbir_info->horizontal.filter_enum == STBIR_FILTER_POINT_SAMPLE ) && ( stbir_info->horizontal.scale_info.scale == 1.0f ) )
6206 STBIR_MEMCPY( output_buffer, input_buffer, stbir_info->horizontal.scale_info.output_sub_size * sizeof( float ) * stbir_info->effective_channels );
6207 else
6208 stbir_info->horizontal_gather_channels( output_buffer, stbir_info->horizontal.scale_info.output_sub_size, decode_buffer, stbir_info->horizontal.contributors, stbir_info->horizontal.coefficients, stbir_info->horizontal.coefficient_width );
6209 STBIR_PROFILE_END( horizontal );
6210}
6211
6212static void stbir__resample_vertical_gather(stbir__info const * stbir_info, stbir__per_split_info* split_info, int n, int contrib_n0, int contrib_n1, float const * vertical_coefficients )
6213{
6214 float* encode_buffer = split_info->vertical_buffer;
6215 float* decode_buffer = split_info->decode_buffer;
6216 int vertical_first = stbir_info->vertical_first;
6217 int width = (vertical_first) ? ( stbir_info->scanline_extents.conservative.n1-stbir_info->scanline_extents.conservative.n0+1 ) : stbir_info->horizontal.scale_info.output_sub_size;
6218 int width_times_channels = stbir_info->effective_channels * width;
6219
6220 STBIR_ASSERT( stbir_info->vertical.is_gather );
6221
6222 // loop over the contributing scanlines and scale into the buffer
6223 STBIR_PROFILE_START( vertical );
6224 {
6225 int k = 0, total = contrib_n1 - contrib_n0 + 1;
6226 STBIR_ASSERT( total > 0 );
6227 do {
6228 float const * inputs[8];
6229 int i, cnt = total; if ( cnt > 8 ) cnt = 8;
6230 for( i = 0 ; i < cnt ; i++ )
6231 inputs[ i ] = stbir__get_ring_buffer_scanline(stbir_info, split_info, k+i+contrib_n0 );
6232
6233 // call the N scanlines at a time function (up to 8 scanlines of blending at once)
6234 ((k==0)?stbir__vertical_gathers:stbir__vertical_gathers_continues)[cnt-1]( (vertical_first) ? decode_buffer : encode_buffer, vertical_coefficients + k, inputs, inputs[0] + width_times_channels );
6235 k += cnt;
6236 total -= cnt;
6237 } while ( total );
6238 }
6239 STBIR_PROFILE_END( vertical );
6240
6241 if ( vertical_first )
6242 {
6243 // Now resample the gathered vertical data in the horizontal axis into the encode buffer
6244 decode_buffer[ width_times_channels ] = 0.0f; // clear two over for horizontals with a remnant of 3
6245 decode_buffer[ width_times_channels+1 ] = 0.0f;
6246 stbir__resample_horizontal_gather(stbir_info, encode_buffer, decode_buffer STBIR_ONLY_PROFILE_SET_SPLIT_INFO );
6247 }
6248
6249 stbir__encode_scanline( stbir_info, ( (char *) stbir_info->output_data ) + ((size_t)n * (size_t)stbir_info->output_stride_bytes),
6250 encode_buffer, n STBIR_ONLY_PROFILE_SET_SPLIT_INFO );
6251}
6252
6253static void stbir__decode_and_resample_for_vertical_gather_loop(stbir__info const * stbir_info, stbir__per_split_info* split_info, int n)
6254{
6255 int ring_buffer_index;
6256 float* ring_buffer;
6257
6258 // Decode the nth scanline from the source image into the decode buffer.
6259 stbir__decode_scanline( stbir_info, n, split_info->decode_buffer STBIR_ONLY_PROFILE_SET_SPLIT_INFO );
6260
6261 // update new end scanline
6262 split_info->ring_buffer_last_scanline = n;
6263
6264 // get ring buffer
6265 ring_buffer_index = (split_info->ring_buffer_begin_index + (split_info->ring_buffer_last_scanline - split_info->ring_buffer_first_scanline)) % stbir_info->ring_buffer_num_entries;
6266 ring_buffer = stbir__get_ring_buffer_entry(stbir_info, split_info, ring_buffer_index);
6267
6268 // Now resample it into the ring buffer.
6269 stbir__resample_horizontal_gather( stbir_info, ring_buffer, split_info->decode_buffer STBIR_ONLY_PROFILE_SET_SPLIT_INFO );
6270
6271 // Now it's sitting in the ring buffer ready to be used as source for the vertical sampling.
6272}
6273
6274static void stbir__vertical_gather_loop( stbir__info const * stbir_info, stbir__per_split_info* split_info, int split_count )
6275{
6276 int y, start_output_y, end_output_y;
6277 stbir__contributors* vertical_contributors = stbir_info->vertical.contributors;
6278 float const * vertical_coefficients = stbir_info->vertical.coefficients;
6279
6280 STBIR_ASSERT( stbir_info->vertical.is_gather );
6281
6282 start_output_y = split_info->start_output_y;
6283 end_output_y = split_info[split_count-1].end_output_y;
6284
6285 vertical_contributors += start_output_y;
6286 vertical_coefficients += start_output_y * stbir_info->vertical.coefficient_width;
6287
6288 // initialize the ring buffer for gathering
6289 split_info->ring_buffer_begin_index = 0;
6290 split_info->ring_buffer_first_scanline = vertical_contributors->n0;
6291 split_info->ring_buffer_last_scanline = split_info->ring_buffer_first_scanline - 1; // means "empty"
6292
6293 for (y = start_output_y; y < end_output_y; y++)
6294 {
6295 int in_first_scanline, in_last_scanline;
6296
6297 in_first_scanline = vertical_contributors->n0;
6298 in_last_scanline = vertical_contributors->n1;
6299
6300 // make sure the indexing hasn't broken
6301 STBIR_ASSERT( in_first_scanline >= split_info->ring_buffer_first_scanline );
6302
6303 // Load in new scanlines
6304 while (in_last_scanline > split_info->ring_buffer_last_scanline)
6305 {
6306 STBIR_ASSERT( ( split_info->ring_buffer_last_scanline - split_info->ring_buffer_first_scanline + 1 ) <= stbir_info->ring_buffer_num_entries );
6307
6308 // make sure there was room in the ring buffer when we add new scanlines
6309 if ( ( split_info->ring_buffer_last_scanline - split_info->ring_buffer_first_scanline + 1 ) == stbir_info->ring_buffer_num_entries )
6310 {
6311 split_info->ring_buffer_first_scanline++;
6312 split_info->ring_buffer_begin_index++;
6313 }
6314
6315 if ( stbir_info->vertical_first )
6316 {
6317 float * ring_buffer = stbir__get_ring_buffer_scanline( stbir_info, split_info, ++split_info->ring_buffer_last_scanline );
6318 // Decode the nth scanline from the source image into the decode buffer.
6319 stbir__decode_scanline( stbir_info, split_info->ring_buffer_last_scanline, ring_buffer STBIR_ONLY_PROFILE_SET_SPLIT_INFO );
6320 }
6321 else
6322 {
6323 stbir__decode_and_resample_for_vertical_gather_loop(stbir_info, split_info, split_info->ring_buffer_last_scanline + 1);
6324 }
6325 }
6326
6327 // Now all buffers should be ready to write a row of vertical sampling, so do it.
6328 stbir__resample_vertical_gather(stbir_info, split_info, y, in_first_scanline, in_last_scanline, vertical_coefficients );
6329
6330 ++vertical_contributors;
6331 vertical_coefficients += stbir_info->vertical.coefficient_width;
6332 }
6333}
6334
6335#define STBIR__FLOAT_EMPTY_MARKER 3.0e+38F
6336#define STBIR__FLOAT_BUFFER_IS_EMPTY(ptr) ((ptr)[0]==STBIR__FLOAT_EMPTY_MARKER)
6337
6338static void stbir__encode_first_scanline_from_scatter(stbir__info const * stbir_info, stbir__per_split_info* split_info)
6339{
6340 // evict a scanline out into the output buffer
6341 float* ring_buffer_entry = stbir__get_ring_buffer_entry(stbir_info, split_info, split_info->ring_buffer_begin_index );
6342
6343 // dump the scanline out
6344 stbir__encode_scanline( stbir_info, ( (char *)stbir_info->output_data ) + ( (size_t)split_info->ring_buffer_first_scanline * (size_t)stbir_info->output_stride_bytes ), ring_buffer_entry, split_info->ring_buffer_first_scanline STBIR_ONLY_PROFILE_SET_SPLIT_INFO );
6345
6346 // mark it as empty
6347 ring_buffer_entry[ 0 ] = STBIR__FLOAT_EMPTY_MARKER;
6348
6349 // advance the first scanline
6350 split_info->ring_buffer_first_scanline++;
6351 if ( ++split_info->ring_buffer_begin_index == stbir_info->ring_buffer_num_entries )
6352 split_info->ring_buffer_begin_index = 0;
6353}
6354
6355static void stbir__horizontal_resample_and_encode_first_scanline_from_scatter(stbir__info const * stbir_info, stbir__per_split_info* split_info)
6356{
6357 // evict a scanline out into the output buffer
6358
6359 float* ring_buffer_entry = stbir__get_ring_buffer_entry(stbir_info, split_info, split_info->ring_buffer_begin_index );
6360
6361 // Now resample it into the buffer.
6362 stbir__resample_horizontal_gather( stbir_info, split_info->vertical_buffer, ring_buffer_entry STBIR_ONLY_PROFILE_SET_SPLIT_INFO );
6363
6364 // dump the scanline out
6365 stbir__encode_scanline( stbir_info, ( (char *)stbir_info->output_data ) + ( (size_t)split_info->ring_buffer_first_scanline * (size_t)stbir_info->output_stride_bytes ), split_info->vertical_buffer, split_info->ring_buffer_first_scanline STBIR_ONLY_PROFILE_SET_SPLIT_INFO );
6366
6367 // mark it as empty
6368 ring_buffer_entry[ 0 ] = STBIR__FLOAT_EMPTY_MARKER;
6369
6370 // advance the first scanline
6371 split_info->ring_buffer_first_scanline++;
6372 if ( ++split_info->ring_buffer_begin_index == stbir_info->ring_buffer_num_entries )
6373 split_info->ring_buffer_begin_index = 0;
6374}
6375
6376static void stbir__resample_vertical_scatter(stbir__info const * stbir_info, stbir__per_split_info* split_info, int n0, int n1, float const * vertical_coefficients, float const * vertical_buffer, float const * vertical_buffer_end )
6377{
6378 STBIR_ASSERT( !stbir_info->vertical.is_gather );
6379
6380 STBIR_PROFILE_START( vertical );
6381 {
6382 int k = 0, total = n1 - n0 + 1;
6383 STBIR_ASSERT( total > 0 );
6384 do {
6385 float * outputs[8];
6386 int i, n = total; if ( n > 8 ) n = 8;
6387 for( i = 0 ; i < n ; i++ )
6388 {
6389 outputs[ i ] = stbir__get_ring_buffer_scanline(stbir_info, split_info, k+i+n0 );
6390 if ( ( i ) && ( STBIR__FLOAT_BUFFER_IS_EMPTY( outputs[i] ) != STBIR__FLOAT_BUFFER_IS_EMPTY( outputs[0] ) ) ) // make sure runs are of the same type
6391 {
6392 n = i;
6393 break;
6394 }
6395 }
6396 // call the scatter to N scanlines at a time function (up to 8 scanlines of scattering at once)
6397 ((STBIR__FLOAT_BUFFER_IS_EMPTY( outputs[0] ))?stbir__vertical_scatter_sets:stbir__vertical_scatter_blends)[n-1]( outputs, vertical_coefficients + k, vertical_buffer, vertical_buffer_end );
6398 k += n;
6399 total -= n;
6400 } while ( total );
6401 }
6402
6403 STBIR_PROFILE_END( vertical );
6404}
6405
6406typedef void stbir__handle_scanline_for_scatter_func(stbir__info const * stbir_info, stbir__per_split_info* split_info);
6407
6408static void stbir__vertical_scatter_loop( stbir__info const * stbir_info, stbir__per_split_info* split_info, int split_count )
6409{
6410 int y, start_output_y, end_output_y, start_input_y, end_input_y;
6411 stbir__contributors* vertical_contributors = stbir_info->vertical.contributors;
6412 float const * vertical_coefficients = stbir_info->vertical.coefficients;
6413 stbir__handle_scanline_for_scatter_func * handle_scanline_for_scatter;
6414 void * scanline_scatter_buffer;
6415 void * scanline_scatter_buffer_end;
6416 int on_first_input_y, last_input_y;
6417 int width = (stbir_info->vertical_first) ? ( stbir_info->scanline_extents.conservative.n1-stbir_info->scanline_extents.conservative.n0+1 ) : stbir_info->horizontal.scale_info.output_sub_size;
6418 int width_times_channels = stbir_info->effective_channels * width;
6419
6420 STBIR_ASSERT( !stbir_info->vertical.is_gather );
6421
6422 start_output_y = split_info->start_output_y;
6423 end_output_y = split_info[split_count-1].end_output_y; // may do multiple split counts
6424
6425 start_input_y = split_info->start_input_y;
6426 end_input_y = split_info[split_count-1].end_input_y;
6427
6428 // adjust for starting offset start_input_y
6429 y = start_input_y + stbir_info->vertical.filter_pixel_margin;
6430 vertical_contributors += y ;
6431 vertical_coefficients += stbir_info->vertical.coefficient_width * y;
6432
6433 if ( stbir_info->vertical_first )
6434 {
6435 handle_scanline_for_scatter = stbir__horizontal_resample_and_encode_first_scanline_from_scatter;
6436 scanline_scatter_buffer = split_info->decode_buffer;
6437 scanline_scatter_buffer_end = ( (char*) scanline_scatter_buffer ) + sizeof( float ) * stbir_info->effective_channels * (stbir_info->scanline_extents.conservative.n1-stbir_info->scanline_extents.conservative.n0+1);
6438 }
6439 else
6440 {
6441 handle_scanline_for_scatter = stbir__encode_first_scanline_from_scatter;
6442 scanline_scatter_buffer = split_info->vertical_buffer;
6443 scanline_scatter_buffer_end = ( (char*) scanline_scatter_buffer ) + sizeof( float ) * stbir_info->effective_channels * stbir_info->horizontal.scale_info.output_sub_size;
6444 }
6445
6446 // initialize the ring buffer for scattering
6447 split_info->ring_buffer_first_scanline = start_output_y;
6448 split_info->ring_buffer_last_scanline = -1;
6449 split_info->ring_buffer_begin_index = -1;
6450
6451 // mark all the buffers as empty to start
6452 for( y = 0 ; y < stbir_info->ring_buffer_num_entries ; y++ )
6453 {
6454 float * decode_buffer = stbir__get_ring_buffer_entry( stbir_info, split_info, y );
6455 decode_buffer[ width_times_channels ] = 0.0f; // clear two over for horizontals with a remnant of 3
6456 decode_buffer[ width_times_channels+1 ] = 0.0f;
6457 decode_buffer[0] = STBIR__FLOAT_EMPTY_MARKER; // only used on scatter
6458 }
6459
6460 // do the loop in input space
6461 on_first_input_y = 1; last_input_y = start_input_y;
6462 for (y = start_input_y ; y < end_input_y; y++)
6463 {
6464 int out_first_scanline, out_last_scanline;
6465
6466 out_first_scanline = vertical_contributors->n0;
6467 out_last_scanline = vertical_contributors->n1;
6468
6469 STBIR_ASSERT(out_last_scanline - out_first_scanline + 1 <= stbir_info->ring_buffer_num_entries);
6470
6471 if ( ( out_last_scanline >= out_first_scanline ) && ( ( ( out_first_scanline >= start_output_y ) && ( out_first_scanline < end_output_y ) ) || ( ( out_last_scanline >= start_output_y ) && ( out_last_scanline < end_output_y ) ) ) )
6472 {
6473 float const * vc = vertical_coefficients;
6474
6475 // keep track of the range actually seen for the next resize
6476 last_input_y = y;
6477 if ( ( on_first_input_y ) && ( y > start_input_y ) )
6478 split_info->start_input_y = y;
6479 on_first_input_y = 0;
6480
6481 // clip the region
6482 if ( out_first_scanline < start_output_y )
6483 {
6484 vc += start_output_y - out_first_scanline;
6485 out_first_scanline = start_output_y;
6486 }
6487
6488 if ( out_last_scanline >= end_output_y )
6489 out_last_scanline = end_output_y - 1;
6490
6491 // if very first scanline, init the index
6492 if (split_info->ring_buffer_begin_index < 0)
6493 split_info->ring_buffer_begin_index = out_first_scanline - start_output_y;
6494
6495 STBIR_ASSERT( split_info->ring_buffer_begin_index <= out_first_scanline );
6496
6497 // Decode the nth scanline from the source image into the decode buffer.
6498 stbir__decode_scanline( stbir_info, y, split_info->decode_buffer STBIR_ONLY_PROFILE_SET_SPLIT_INFO );
6499
6500 // When horizontal first, we resample horizontally into the vertical buffer before we scatter it out
6501 if ( !stbir_info->vertical_first )
6502 stbir__resample_horizontal_gather( stbir_info, split_info->vertical_buffer, split_info->decode_buffer STBIR_ONLY_PROFILE_SET_SPLIT_INFO );
6503
6504 // Now it's sitting in the buffer ready to be distributed into the ring buffers.
6505
6506 // evict from the ringbuffer, if we need are full
6507 if ( ( ( split_info->ring_buffer_last_scanline - split_info->ring_buffer_first_scanline + 1 ) == stbir_info->ring_buffer_num_entries ) &&
6508 ( out_last_scanline > split_info->ring_buffer_last_scanline ) )
6509 handle_scanline_for_scatter( stbir_info, split_info );
6510
6511 // Now the horizontal buffer is ready to write to all ring buffer rows, so do it.
6512 stbir__resample_vertical_scatter(stbir_info, split_info, out_first_scanline, out_last_scanline, vc, (float*)scanline_scatter_buffer, (float*)scanline_scatter_buffer_end );
6513
6514 // update the end of the buffer
6515 if ( out_last_scanline > split_info->ring_buffer_last_scanline )
6516 split_info->ring_buffer_last_scanline = out_last_scanline;
6517 }
6518 ++vertical_contributors;
6519 vertical_coefficients += stbir_info->vertical.coefficient_width;
6520 }
6521
6522 // now evict the scanlines that are left over in the ring buffer
6523 while ( split_info->ring_buffer_first_scanline < end_output_y )
6524 handle_scanline_for_scatter(stbir_info, split_info);
6525
6526 // update the end_input_y if we do multiple resizes with the same data
6527 ++last_input_y;
6528 for( y = 0 ; y < split_count; y++ )
6529 if ( split_info[y].end_input_y > last_input_y )
6530 split_info[y].end_input_y = last_input_y;
6531}
6532
6533
6534static stbir__kernel_callback * stbir__builtin_kernels[] = { 0, stbir__filter_trapezoid, stbir__filter_triangle, stbir__filter_cubic, stbir__filter_catmullrom, stbir__filter_mitchell, stbir__filter_point };
6535static stbir__support_callback * stbir__builtin_supports[] = { 0, stbir__support_trapezoid, stbir__support_one, stbir__support_two, stbir__support_two, stbir__support_two, stbir__support_zeropoint5 };
6536
6537static void stbir__set_sampler(stbir__sampler * samp, stbir_filter filter, stbir__kernel_callback * kernel, stbir__support_callback * support, stbir_edge edge, stbir__scale_info * scale_info, int always_gather, void * user_data )
6538{
6539 // set filter
6540 if (filter == 0)
6541 {
6542 filter = STBIR_DEFAULT_FILTER_DOWNSAMPLE; // default to downsample
6543 if (scale_info->scale >= ( 1.0f - stbir__small_float ) )
6544 {
6545 if ( (scale_info->scale <= ( 1.0f + stbir__small_float ) ) && ( STBIR_CEILF(scale_info->pixel_shift) == scale_info->pixel_shift ) )
6546 filter = STBIR_FILTER_POINT_SAMPLE;
6547 else
6548 filter = STBIR_DEFAULT_FILTER_UPSAMPLE;
6549 }
6550 }
6551 samp->filter_enum = filter;
6552
6553 STBIR_ASSERT(samp->filter_enum != 0);
6554 STBIR_ASSERT((unsigned)samp->filter_enum < STBIR_FILTER_OTHER);
6555 samp->filter_kernel = stbir__builtin_kernels[ filter ];
6556 samp->filter_support = stbir__builtin_supports[ filter ];
6557
6558 if ( kernel && support )
6559 {
6560 samp->filter_kernel = kernel;
6561 samp->filter_support = support;
6562 samp->filter_enum = STBIR_FILTER_OTHER;
6563 }
6564
6565 samp->edge = edge;
6566 samp->filter_pixel_width = stbir__get_filter_pixel_width (samp->filter_support, scale_info->scale, user_data );
6567 // Gather is always better, but in extreme downsamples, you have to most or all of the data in memory
6568 // For horizontal, we always have all the pixels, so we always use gather here (always_gather==1).
6569 // For vertical, we use gather if scaling up (which means we will have samp->filter_pixel_width
6570 // scanlines in memory at once).
6571 samp->is_gather = 0;
6572 if ( scale_info->scale >= ( 1.0f - stbir__small_float ) )
6573 samp->is_gather = 1;
6574 else if ( ( always_gather ) || ( samp->filter_pixel_width <= STBIR_FORCE_GATHER_FILTER_SCANLINES_AMOUNT ) )
6575 samp->is_gather = 2;
6576
6577 // pre calculate stuff based on the above
6578 samp->coefficient_width = stbir__get_coefficient_width(samp, samp->is_gather, user_data);
6579
6580 // filter_pixel_width is the conservative size in pixels of input that affect an output pixel.
6581 // In rare cases (only with 2 pix to 1 pix with the default filters), it's possible that the
6582 // filter will extend before or after the scanline beyond just one extra entire copy of the
6583 // scanline (we would hit the edge twice). We don't let you do that, so we clamp the total
6584 // width to 3x the total of input pixel (once for the scanline, once for the left side
6585 // overhang, and once for the right side). We only do this for edge mode, since the other
6586 // modes can just re-edge clamp back in again.
6587 if ( edge == STBIR_EDGE_WRAP )
6588 if ( samp->filter_pixel_width > ( scale_info->input_full_size * 3 ) )
6589 samp->filter_pixel_width = scale_info->input_full_size * 3;
6590
6591 // This is how much to expand buffers to account for filters seeking outside
6592 // the image boundaries.
6593 samp->filter_pixel_margin = samp->filter_pixel_width / 2;
6594
6595 // filter_pixel_margin is the amount that this filter can overhang on just one side of either
6596 // end of the scanline (left or the right). Since we only allow you to overhang 1 scanline's
6597 // worth of pixels, we clamp this one side of overhang to the input scanline size. Again,
6598 // this clamping only happens in rare cases with the default filters (2 pix to 1 pix).
6599 if ( edge == STBIR_EDGE_WRAP )
6600 if ( samp->filter_pixel_margin > scale_info->input_full_size )
6601 samp->filter_pixel_margin = scale_info->input_full_size;
6602
6603 samp->num_contributors = stbir__get_contributors(samp, samp->is_gather);
6604
6605 samp->contributors_size = samp->num_contributors * sizeof(stbir__contributors);
6606 samp->coefficients_size = samp->num_contributors * samp->coefficient_width * sizeof(float) + sizeof(float)*STBIR_INPUT_CALLBACK_PADDING; // extra sizeof(float) is padding
6607
6608 samp->gather_prescatter_contributors = 0;
6609 samp->gather_prescatter_coefficients = 0;
6610 if ( samp->is_gather == 0 )
6611 {
6612 samp->gather_prescatter_coefficient_width = samp->filter_pixel_width;
6613 samp->gather_prescatter_num_contributors = stbir__get_contributors(samp, 2);
6614 samp->gather_prescatter_contributors_size = samp->gather_prescatter_num_contributors * sizeof(stbir__contributors);
6615 samp->gather_prescatter_coefficients_size = samp->gather_prescatter_num_contributors * samp->gather_prescatter_coefficient_width * sizeof(float);
6616 }
6617}
6618
6619static void stbir__get_conservative_extents( stbir__sampler * samp, stbir__contributors * range, void * user_data )
6620{
6621 float scale = samp->scale_info.scale;
6622 float out_shift = samp->scale_info.pixel_shift;
6623 stbir__support_callback * support = samp->filter_support;
6624 int input_full_size = samp->scale_info.input_full_size;
6625 stbir_edge edge = samp->edge;
6626 float inv_scale = samp->scale_info.inv_scale;
6627
6628 STBIR_ASSERT( samp->is_gather != 0 );
6629
6630 if ( samp->is_gather == 1 )
6631 {
6632 int in_first_pixel, in_last_pixel;
6633 float out_filter_radius = support(inv_scale, user_data) * scale;
6634
6635 stbir__calculate_in_pixel_range( &in_first_pixel, &in_last_pixel, 0.5, out_filter_radius, inv_scale, out_shift, input_full_size, edge );
6636 range->n0 = in_first_pixel;
6637 stbir__calculate_in_pixel_range( &in_first_pixel, &in_last_pixel, ( (float)(samp->scale_info.output_sub_size-1) ) + 0.5f, out_filter_radius, inv_scale, out_shift, input_full_size, edge );
6638 range->n1 = in_last_pixel;
6639 }
6640 else if ( samp->is_gather == 2 ) // downsample gather, refine
6641 {
6642 float in_pixels_radius = support(scale, user_data) * inv_scale;
6643 int filter_pixel_margin = samp->filter_pixel_margin;
6644 int output_sub_size = samp->scale_info.output_sub_size;
6645 int input_end;
6646 int n;
6647 int in_first_pixel, in_last_pixel;
6648
6649 // get a conservative area of the input range
6650 stbir__calculate_in_pixel_range( &in_first_pixel, &in_last_pixel, 0, 0, inv_scale, out_shift, input_full_size, edge );
6651 range->n0 = in_first_pixel;
6652 stbir__calculate_in_pixel_range( &in_first_pixel, &in_last_pixel, (float)output_sub_size, 0, inv_scale, out_shift, input_full_size, edge );
6653 range->n1 = in_last_pixel;
6654
6655 // now go through the margin to the start of area to find bottom
6656 n = range->n0 + 1;
6657 input_end = -filter_pixel_margin;
6658 while( n >= input_end )
6659 {
6660 int out_first_pixel, out_last_pixel;
6661 stbir__calculate_out_pixel_range( &out_first_pixel, &out_last_pixel, ((float)n)+0.5f, in_pixels_radius, scale, out_shift, output_sub_size );
6662 if ( out_first_pixel > out_last_pixel )
6663 break;
6664
6665 if ( ( out_first_pixel < output_sub_size ) || ( out_last_pixel >= 0 ) )
6666 range->n0 = n;
6667 --n;
6668 }
6669
6670 // now go through the end of the area through the margin to find top
6671 n = range->n1 - 1;
6672 input_end = n + 1 + filter_pixel_margin;
6673 while( n <= input_end )
6674 {
6675 int out_first_pixel, out_last_pixel;
6676 stbir__calculate_out_pixel_range( &out_first_pixel, &out_last_pixel, ((float)n)+0.5f, in_pixels_radius, scale, out_shift, output_sub_size );
6677 if ( out_first_pixel > out_last_pixel )
6678 break;
6679 if ( ( out_first_pixel < output_sub_size ) || ( out_last_pixel >= 0 ) )
6680 range->n1 = n;
6681 ++n;
6682 }
6683 }
6684
6685 if ( samp->edge == STBIR_EDGE_WRAP )
6686 {
6687 // if we are wrapping, and we are very close to the image size (so the edges might merge), just use the scanline up to the edge
6688 if ( ( range->n0 > 0 ) && ( range->n1 >= input_full_size ) )
6689 {
6690 int marg = range->n1 - input_full_size + 1;
6691 if ( ( marg + STBIR__MERGE_RUNS_PIXEL_THRESHOLD ) >= range->n0 )
6692 range->n0 = 0;
6693 }
6694 if ( ( range->n0 < 0 ) && ( range->n1 < (input_full_size-1) ) )
6695 {
6696 int marg = -range->n0;
6697 if ( ( input_full_size - marg - STBIR__MERGE_RUNS_PIXEL_THRESHOLD - 1 ) <= range->n1 )
6698 range->n1 = input_full_size - 1;
6699 }
6700 }
6701 else
6702 {
6703 // for non-edge-wrap modes, we never read over the edge, so clamp
6704 if ( range->n0 < 0 )
6705 range->n0 = 0;
6706 if ( range->n1 >= input_full_size )
6707 range->n1 = input_full_size - 1;
6708 }
6709}

6711static void stbir__get_split_info( stbir__per_split_info* split_info, int splits, int output_height, int vertical_pixel_margin, int input_full_height )
6712{
6713 int i, cur;
6714 int left = output_height;
6715
6716 cur = 0;
6717 for( i = 0 ; i < splits ; i++ )
6718 {
6719 int each;
6720 split_info[i].start_output_y = cur;
6721 each = left / ( splits - i );
6722 split_info[i].end_output_y = cur + each;
6723 cur += each;
6724 left -= each;
6725
6726 // scatter range (updated to minimum as you run it)
6727 split_info[i].start_input_y = -vertical_pixel_margin;
6728 split_info[i].end_input_y = input_full_height + vertical_pixel_margin;
6729 }
6730}

6732static void stbir__free_internal_mem( stbir__info *info )
6733{
6734 #define STBIR__FREE_AND_CLEAR( ptr ) { if ( ptr ) { void * p = (ptr); (ptr) = 0; STBIR_FREE( p, info->user_data); } }
6735
6736 if ( info )
6737 {
6738 #ifndef STBIR__SEPARATE_ALLOCATIONS
6739 STBIR__FREE_AND_CLEAR( info->alloced_mem );
6740 #else
6741 int i,j;
6742
6743 if ( ( info->vertical.gather_prescatter_contributors ) && ( (void*)info->vertical.gather_prescatter_contributors != (void*)info->split_info[0].decode_buffer ) )
6744 {
6745 STBIR__FREE_AND_CLEAR( info->vertical.gather_prescatter_coefficients );
6746 STBIR__FREE_AND_CLEAR( info->vertical.gather_prescatter_contributors );
6747 }
6748 for( i = 0 ; i < info->splits ; i++ )
6749 {
6750 for( j = 0 ; j < info->alloc_ring_buffer_num_entries ; j++ )
6751 {
6752 #ifdef STBIR_SIMD8
6753 if ( info->effective_channels == 3 )
6754 --info->split_info[i].ring_buffers[j]; // avx in 3 channel mode needs one float at the start of the buffer
6755 #endif
6756 STBIR__FREE_AND_CLEAR( info->split_info[i].ring_buffers[j] );
6757 }
6758
6759 #ifdef STBIR_SIMD8
6760 if ( info->effective_channels == 3 )
6761 --info->split_info[i].decode_buffer; // avx in 3 channel mode needs one float at the start of the buffer
6762 #endif
6763 STBIR__FREE_AND_CLEAR( info->split_info[i].decode_buffer );
6764 STBIR__FREE_AND_CLEAR( info->split_info[i].ring_buffers );
6765 STBIR__FREE_AND_CLEAR( info->split_info[i].vertical_buffer );
6766 }
6767 STBIR__FREE_AND_CLEAR( info->split_info );
6768 if ( info->vertical.coefficients != info->horizontal.coefficients )
6769 {
6770 STBIR__FREE_AND_CLEAR( info->vertical.coefficients );
6771 STBIR__FREE_AND_CLEAR( info->vertical.contributors );
6772 }
6773 STBIR__FREE_AND_CLEAR( info->horizontal.coefficients );
6774 STBIR__FREE_AND_CLEAR( info->horizontal.contributors );
6775 STBIR__FREE_AND_CLEAR( info->alloced_mem );
6776 STBIR_FREE( info, info->user_data );
6777 #endif
6778 }
6779
6780 #undef STBIR__FREE_AND_CLEAR
6781}

6783static int stbir__get_max_split( int splits, int height )
6784{
6785 int i;
6786 int max = 0;
6787
6788 for( i = 0 ; i < splits ; i++ )
6789 {
6790 int each = height / ( splits - i );
6791 if ( each > max )
6792 max = each;
6793 height -= each;
6794 }
6795 return max;
6796}

6861// structure that allow us to query and override info for training the costs
6862typedef struct STBIR__V_FIRST_INFO
6863{
6864 double v_cost, h_cost;
6865 int control_v_first; // 0 = no control, 1 = force hori, 2 = force vert
6866 int v_first;
6867 int v_resize_classification;
6868 int is_gather;
6869} STBIR__V_FIRST_INFO;
6870
6871#ifdef STBIR__V_FIRST_INFO_BUFFER
6872static STBIR__V_FIRST_INFO STBIR__V_FIRST_INFO_BUFFER = {0};
6873#define STBIR__V_FIRST_INFO_POINTER &STBIR__V_FIRST_INFO_BUFFER
6874#else
6875#define STBIR__V_FIRST_INFO_POINTER 0
6876#endif
6877
6878// Figure out whether to scale along the horizontal or vertical first.
6879// This only *super* important when you are scaling by a massively
6880// different amount in the vertical vs the horizontal (for example, if
6881// you are scaling by 2x in the width, and 0.5x in the height, then you
6882// want to do the vertical scale first, because it's around 3x faster
6883// in that order.
6884//
6885// In more normal circumstances, this makes a 20-40% differences, so
6886// it's good to get right, but not critical. The normal way that you
6887// decide which direction goes first is just figuring out which
6888// direction does more multiplies. But with modern CPUs with their
6889// fancy caches and SIMD and high IPC abilities, so there's just a lot
6890// more that goes into it.
6891//
6892// My handwavy sort of solution is to have an app that does a whole
6893// bunch of timing for both vertical and horizontal first modes,
6894// and then another app that can read lots of these timing files
6895// and try to search for the best weights to use. Dotimings.c
6896// is the app that does a bunch of timings, and vf_train.c is the
6897// app that solves for the best weights (and shows how well it
6898// does currently).
6899
6900static int stbir__should_do_vertical_first( float weights_table[STBIR_RESIZE_CLASSIFICATIONS][4], int horizontal_filter_pixel_width, float horizontal_scale, int horizontal_output_size, int vertical_filter_pixel_width, float vertical_scale, int vertical_output_size, int is_gather, STBIR__V_FIRST_INFO * info )
6901{
6902 double v_cost, h_cost;
6903 float * weights;
6904 int vertical_first;
6905 int v_classification;
6906
6907 // categorize the resize into buckets
6908 if ( ( vertical_output_size <= 4 ) || ( horizontal_output_size <= 4 ) )
6909 v_classification = ( vertical_output_size < horizontal_output_size ) ? 6 : 7;
6910 else if ( vertical_scale <= 1.0f )
6911 v_classification = ( is_gather ) ? 1 : 0;
6912 else if ( vertical_scale <= 2.0f)
6913 v_classification = 2;
6914 else if ( vertical_scale <= 3.0f)
6915 v_classification = 3;
6916 else if ( vertical_scale <= 4.0f)
6917 v_classification = 5;
6918 else
6919 v_classification = 6;
6920
6921 // use the right weights
6922 weights = weights_table[ v_classification ];
6923
6924 // this is the costs when you don't take into account modern CPUs with high ipc and simd and caches - wish we had a better estimate
6925 h_cost = (float)horizontal_filter_pixel_width * weights[0] + horizontal_scale * (float)vertical_filter_pixel_width * weights[1];
6926 v_cost = (float)vertical_filter_pixel_width * weights[2] + vertical_scale * (float)horizontal_filter_pixel_width * weights[3];
6927
6928 // use computation estimate to decide vertical first or not
6929 vertical_first = ( v_cost <= h_cost ) ? 1 : 0;
6930
6931 // save these, if requested
6932 if ( info )
6933 {
6934 info->h_cost = h_cost;
6935 info->v_cost = v_cost;
6936 info->v_resize_classification = v_classification;
6937 info->v_first = vertical_first;
6938 info->is_gather = is_gather;
6939 }
6940
6941 // and this allows us to override everything for testing (see dotiming.c)
6942 if ( ( info ) && ( info->control_v_first ) )
6943 vertical_first = ( info->control_v_first == 2 ) ? 1 : 0;
6944
6945 return vertical_first;
6946}

6949static unsigned char stbir__pixel_channels[] = {
6950 1,2,3,3,4, // 1ch, 2ch, rgb, bgr, 4ch
6951 4,4,4,4,2,2, // RGBA,BGRA,ARGB,ABGR,RA,AR
6952 4,4,4,4,2,2, // RGBA_PM,BGRA_PM,ARGB_PM,ABGR_PM,RA_PM,AR_PM
6953};

6956// the public pixel layout is ordered in a way that if you cast num_channels (1-4) to the enum, you get something sensible
6957static stbir_internal_pixel_layout stbir__pixel_layout_convert_public_to_internal[] = {
6958 STBIRI_BGR, STBIRI_1CHANNEL, STBIRI_2CHANNEL, STBIRI_RGB, STBIRI_RGBA,
6959 STBIRI_4CHANNEL, STBIRI_BGRA, STBIRI_ARGB, STBIRI_ABGR, STBIRI_RA, STBIRI_AR,
6960 STBIRI_RGBA_PM, STBIRI_BGRA_PM, STBIRI_ARGB_PM, STBIRI_ABGR_PM, STBIRI_RA_PM, STBIRI_AR_PM,
6961};

6963static stbir__info * stbir__alloc_internal_mem_and_build_samplers( stbir__sampler * horizontal, stbir__sampler * vertical, stbir__contributors * conservative, stbir_pixel_layout input_pixel_layout_public, stbir_pixel_layout output_pixel_layout_public, int splits, int new_x, int new_y, int fast_alpha, void * user_data STBIR_ONLY_PROFILE_BUILD_GET_INFO )
6964{
6965 static char stbir_channel_count_index[8]={ 9,0,1,2, 3,9,9,4 };
6966
6967 stbir__info * info = 0;
6968 void * alloced = 0;
6969 size_t alloced_total = 0;
6970 int vertical_first;
6971 size_t decode_buffer_size, ring_buffer_length_bytes, ring_buffer_size, vertical_buffer_size;
6972 int alloc_ring_buffer_num_entries;
6973
6974 int alpha_weighting_type = 0; // 0=none, 1=simple, 2=fancy
6975 int conservative_split_output_size = stbir__get_max_split( splits, vertical->scale_info.output_sub_size );
6976 stbir_internal_pixel_layout input_pixel_layout = stbir__pixel_layout_convert_public_to_internal[ input_pixel_layout_public ];
6977 stbir_internal_pixel_layout output_pixel_layout = stbir__pixel_layout_convert_public_to_internal[ output_pixel_layout_public ];
6978 int channels = stbir__pixel_channels[ input_pixel_layout ];
6979 int effective_channels = channels;
6980
6981 // first figure out what type of alpha weighting to use (if any)
6982 if ( ( horizontal->filter_enum != STBIR_FILTER_POINT_SAMPLE ) || ( vertical->filter_enum != STBIR_FILTER_POINT_SAMPLE ) ) // no alpha weighting on point sampling
6983 {
6984 if ( ( input_pixel_layout >= STBIRI_RGBA ) && ( input_pixel_layout <= STBIRI_AR ) && ( output_pixel_layout >= STBIRI_RGBA ) && ( output_pixel_layout <= STBIRI_AR ) )
6985 {
6986 if ( fast_alpha )
6987 {
6988 alpha_weighting_type = 4;
6989 }
6990 else
6991 {
6992 static int fancy_alpha_effective_cnts[6] = { 7, 7, 7, 7, 3, 3 };
6993 alpha_weighting_type = 2;
6994 effective_channels = fancy_alpha_effective_cnts[ input_pixel_layout - STBIRI_RGBA ];
6995 }
6996 }
6997 else if ( ( input_pixel_layout >= STBIRI_RGBA_PM ) && ( input_pixel_layout <= STBIRI_AR_PM ) && ( output_pixel_layout >= STBIRI_RGBA ) && ( output_pixel_layout <= STBIRI_AR ) )
6998 {
6999 // input premult, output non-premult
7000 alpha_weighting_type = 3;
7001 }
7002 else if ( ( input_pixel_layout >= STBIRI_RGBA ) && ( input_pixel_layout <= STBIRI_AR ) && ( output_pixel_layout >= STBIRI_RGBA_PM ) && ( output_pixel_layout <= STBIRI_AR_PM ) )
7003 {
7004 // input non-premult, output premult
7005 alpha_weighting_type = 1;
7006 }
7007 }
7008
7009 // channel in and out count must match currently
7010 if ( channels != stbir__pixel_channels[ output_pixel_layout ] )
7011 return 0;
7012
7013 // get vertical first
7014 vertical_first = stbir__should_do_vertical_first( stbir__compute_weights[ (int)stbir_channel_count_index[ effective_channels ] ], horizontal->filter_pixel_width, horizontal->scale_info.scale, horizontal->scale_info.output_sub_size, vertical->filter_pixel_width, vertical->scale_info.scale, vertical->scale_info.output_sub_size, vertical->is_gather, STBIR__V_FIRST_INFO_POINTER );
7015
7016 // sometimes read one float off in some of the unrolled loops (with a weight of zero coeff, so it doesn't have an effect)
7017 // we use a few extra floats instead of just 1, so that input callback buffer can overlap with the decode buffer without
7018 // the conversion routines overwriting the callback input data.
7019 decode_buffer_size = ( conservative->n1 - conservative->n0 + 1 ) * effective_channels * sizeof(float) + sizeof(float)*STBIR_INPUT_CALLBACK_PADDING; // extra floats for input callback stagger
7020
7021#if defined( STBIR__SEPARATE_ALLOCATIONS ) && defined(STBIR_SIMD8)
7022 if ( effective_channels == 3 )
7023 decode_buffer_size += sizeof(float); // avx in 3 channel mode needs one float at the start of the buffer (only with separate allocations)
7024#endif
7025
7026 ring_buffer_length_bytes = (size_t)horizontal->scale_info.output_sub_size * (size_t)effective_channels * sizeof(float) + sizeof(float)*STBIR_INPUT_CALLBACK_PADDING; // extra floats for padding
7027
7028 // if we do vertical first, the ring buffer holds a whole decoded line
7029 if ( vertical_first )
7030 ring_buffer_length_bytes = ( decode_buffer_size + 15 ) & ~15;
7031
7032 if ( ( ring_buffer_length_bytes & 4095 ) == 0 ) ring_buffer_length_bytes += 64*3; // avoid 4k alias
7033
7034 // One extra entry because floating point precision problems sometimes cause an extra to be necessary.
7035 alloc_ring_buffer_num_entries = vertical->filter_pixel_width + 1;
7036
7037 // we never need more ring buffer entries than the scanlines we're outputting when in scatter mode
7038 if ( ( !vertical->is_gather ) && ( alloc_ring_buffer_num_entries > conservative_split_output_size ) )
7039 alloc_ring_buffer_num_entries = conservative_split_output_size;
7040
7041 ring_buffer_size = (size_t)alloc_ring_buffer_num_entries * (size_t)ring_buffer_length_bytes;
7042
7043 // The vertical buffer is used differently, depending on whether we are scattering
7044 // the vertical scanlines, or gathering them.
7045 // If scattering, it's used at the temp buffer to accumulate each output.
7046 // If gathering, it's just the output buffer.
7047 vertical_buffer_size = (size_t)horizontal->scale_info.output_sub_size * (size_t)effective_channels * sizeof(float) + sizeof(float); // extra float for padding
7048
7049 // we make two passes through this loop, 1st to add everything up, 2nd to allocate and init
7050 for(;;)
7051 {
7052 int i;
7053 void * advance_mem = alloced;
7054 int copy_horizontal = 0;
7055 stbir__sampler * possibly_use_horizontal_for_pivot = 0;
7056
7057#ifdef STBIR__SEPARATE_ALLOCATIONS
7058 #define STBIR__NEXT_PTR( ptr, size, ntype ) if ( alloced ) { void * p = STBIR_MALLOC( size, user_data); if ( p == 0 ) { stbir__free_internal_mem( info ); return 0; } (ptr) = (ntype*)p; }
7059#else
7060 #define STBIR__NEXT_PTR( ptr, size, ntype ) advance_mem = (void*) ( ( ((size_t)advance_mem) + 15 ) & ~15 ); if ( alloced ) ptr = (ntype*)advance_mem; advance_mem = ((char*)advance_mem) + (size);
7061#endif
7062
7063 STBIR__NEXT_PTR( info, sizeof( stbir__info ), stbir__info );
7064
7065 STBIR__NEXT_PTR( info->split_info, sizeof( stbir__per_split_info ) * splits, stbir__per_split_info );
7066
7067 if ( info )
7068 {
7069 static stbir__alpha_weight_func * fancy_alpha_weights[6] = { stbir__fancy_alpha_weight_4ch, stbir__fancy_alpha_weight_4ch, stbir__fancy_alpha_weight_4ch, stbir__fancy_alpha_weight_4ch, stbir__fancy_alpha_weight_2ch, stbir__fancy_alpha_weight_2ch };
7070 static stbir__alpha_unweight_func * fancy_alpha_unweights[6] = { stbir__fancy_alpha_unweight_4ch, stbir__fancy_alpha_unweight_4ch, stbir__fancy_alpha_unweight_4ch, stbir__fancy_alpha_unweight_4ch, stbir__fancy_alpha_unweight_2ch, stbir__fancy_alpha_unweight_2ch };
7071 static stbir__alpha_weight_func * simple_alpha_weights[6] = { stbir__simple_alpha_weight_4ch, stbir__simple_alpha_weight_4ch, stbir__simple_alpha_weight_4ch, stbir__simple_alpha_weight_4ch, stbir__simple_alpha_weight_2ch, stbir__simple_alpha_weight_2ch };
7072 static stbir__alpha_unweight_func * simple_alpha_unweights[6] = { stbir__simple_alpha_unweight_4ch, stbir__simple_alpha_unweight_4ch, stbir__simple_alpha_unweight_4ch, stbir__simple_alpha_unweight_4ch, stbir__simple_alpha_unweight_2ch, stbir__simple_alpha_unweight_2ch };
7073
7074 // initialize info fields
7075 info->alloced_mem = alloced;
7076 info->alloced_total = alloced_total;
7077
7078 info->channels = channels;
7079 info->effective_channels = effective_channels;
7080
7081 info->offset_x = new_x;
7082 info->offset_y = new_y;
7083 info->alloc_ring_buffer_num_entries = (int)alloc_ring_buffer_num_entries;
7084 info->ring_buffer_num_entries = 0;
7085 info->ring_buffer_length_bytes = (int)ring_buffer_length_bytes;
7086 info->splits = splits;
7087 info->vertical_first = vertical_first;
7088
7089 info->input_pixel_layout_internal = input_pixel_layout;
7090 info->output_pixel_layout_internal = output_pixel_layout;
7091
7092 // setup alpha weight functions
7093 info->alpha_weight = 0;
7094 info->alpha_unweight = 0;
7095
7096 // handle alpha weighting functions and overrides
7097 if ( alpha_weighting_type == 2 )
7098 {
7099 // high quality alpha multiplying on the way in, dividing on the way out
7100 info->alpha_weight = fancy_alpha_weights[ input_pixel_layout - STBIRI_RGBA ];
7101 info->alpha_unweight = fancy_alpha_unweights[ output_pixel_layout - STBIRI_RGBA ];
7102 }
7103 else if ( alpha_weighting_type == 4 )
7104 {
7105 // fast alpha multiplying on the way in, dividing on the way out
7106 info->alpha_weight = simple_alpha_weights[ input_pixel_layout - STBIRI_RGBA ];
7107 info->alpha_unweight = simple_alpha_unweights[ output_pixel_layout - STBIRI_RGBA ];
7108 }
7109 else if ( alpha_weighting_type == 1 )
7110 {
7111 // fast alpha on the way in, leave in premultiplied form on way out
7112 info->alpha_weight = simple_alpha_weights[ input_pixel_layout - STBIRI_RGBA ];
7113 }
7114 else if ( alpha_weighting_type == 3 )
7115 {
7116 // incoming is premultiplied, fast alpha dividing on the way out - non-premultiplied output
7117 info->alpha_unweight = simple_alpha_unweights[ output_pixel_layout - STBIRI_RGBA ];
7118 }
7119
7120 // handle 3-chan color flipping, using the alpha weight path
7121 if ( ( ( input_pixel_layout == STBIRI_RGB ) && ( output_pixel_layout == STBIRI_BGR ) ) ||
7122 ( ( input_pixel_layout == STBIRI_BGR ) && ( output_pixel_layout == STBIRI_RGB ) ) )
7123 {
7124 // do the flipping on the smaller of the two ends
7125 if ( horizontal->scale_info.scale < 1.0f )
7126 info->alpha_unweight = stbir__simple_flip_3ch;
7127 else
7128 info->alpha_weight = stbir__simple_flip_3ch;
7129 }
7130
7131 }
7132
7133 // get all the per-split buffers
7134 for( i = 0 ; i < splits ; i++ )
7135 {
7136 STBIR__NEXT_PTR( info->split_info[i].decode_buffer, decode_buffer_size, float );
7137
7138#ifdef STBIR__SEPARATE_ALLOCATIONS
7139
7140 #ifdef STBIR_SIMD8
7141 if ( ( info ) && ( effective_channels == 3 ) )
7142 ++info->split_info[i].decode_buffer; // avx in 3 channel mode needs one float at the start of the buffer
7143 #endif
7144
7145 STBIR__NEXT_PTR( info->split_info[i].ring_buffers, alloc_ring_buffer_num_entries * sizeof(float*), float* );
7146 {
7147 int j;
7148 for( j = 0 ; j < alloc_ring_buffer_num_entries ; j++ )
7149 {
7150 STBIR__NEXT_PTR( info->split_info[i].ring_buffers[j], ring_buffer_length_bytes, float );
7151 #ifdef STBIR_SIMD8
7152 if ( ( info ) && ( effective_channels == 3 ) )
7153 ++info->split_info[i].ring_buffers[j]; // avx in 3 channel mode needs one float at the start of the buffer
7154 #endif
7155 }
7156 }
7157#else
7158 STBIR__NEXT_PTR( info->split_info[i].ring_buffer, ring_buffer_size, float );
7159#endif
7160 STBIR__NEXT_PTR( info->split_info[i].vertical_buffer, vertical_buffer_size, float );
7161 }
7162
7163 // alloc memory for to-be-pivoted coeffs (if necessary)
7164 if ( vertical->is_gather == 0 )
7165 {
7166 size_t both;
7167 size_t temp_mem_amt;
7168
7169 // when in vertical scatter mode, we first build the coefficients in gather mode, and then pivot after,
7170 // that means we need two buffers, so we try to use the decode buffer and ring buffer for this. if that
7171 // is too small, we just allocate extra memory to use as this temp.
7172
7173 both = (size_t)vertical->gather_prescatter_contributors_size + (size_t)vertical->gather_prescatter_coefficients_size;
7174
7175#ifdef STBIR__SEPARATE_ALLOCATIONS
7176 temp_mem_amt = decode_buffer_size;
7177
7178 #ifdef STBIR_SIMD8
7179 if ( effective_channels == 3 )
7180 --temp_mem_amt; // avx in 3 channel mode needs one float at the start of the buffer
7181 #endif
7182#else
7183 temp_mem_amt = (size_t)( decode_buffer_size + ring_buffer_size + vertical_buffer_size ) * (size_t)splits;
7184#endif
7185 if ( temp_mem_amt >= both )
7186 {
7187 if ( info )
7188 {
7189 vertical->gather_prescatter_contributors = (stbir__contributors*)info->split_info[0].decode_buffer;
7190 vertical->gather_prescatter_coefficients = (float*) ( ( (char*)info->split_info[0].decode_buffer ) + vertical->gather_prescatter_contributors_size );
7191 }
7192 }
7193 else
7194 {
7195 // ring+decode memory is too small, so allocate temp memory
7196 STBIR__NEXT_PTR( vertical->gather_prescatter_contributors, vertical->gather_prescatter_contributors_size, stbir__contributors );
7197 STBIR__NEXT_PTR( vertical->gather_prescatter_coefficients, vertical->gather_prescatter_coefficients_size, float );
7198 }
7199 }
7200
7201 STBIR__NEXT_PTR( horizontal->contributors, horizontal->contributors_size, stbir__contributors );
7202 STBIR__NEXT_PTR( horizontal->coefficients, horizontal->coefficients_size, float );
7203
7204 // are the two filters identical?? (happens a lot with mipmap generation)
7205 if ( ( horizontal->filter_kernel == vertical->filter_kernel ) && ( horizontal->filter_support == vertical->filter_support ) && ( horizontal->edge == vertical->edge ) && ( horizontal->scale_info.output_sub_size == vertical->scale_info.output_sub_size ) )
7206 {
7207 float diff_scale = horizontal->scale_info.scale - vertical->scale_info.scale;
7208 float diff_shift = horizontal->scale_info.pixel_shift - vertical->scale_info.pixel_shift;
7209 if ( diff_scale < 0.0f ) diff_scale = -diff_scale;
7210 if ( diff_shift < 0.0f ) diff_shift = -diff_shift;
7211 if ( ( diff_scale <= stbir__small_float ) && ( diff_shift <= stbir__small_float ) )
7212 {
7213 if ( horizontal->is_gather == vertical->is_gather )
7214 {
7215 copy_horizontal = 1;
7216 goto no_vert_alloc;
7217 }
7218 // everything matches, but vertical is scatter, horizontal is gather, use horizontal coeffs for vertical pivot coeffs
7219 possibly_use_horizontal_for_pivot = horizontal;
7220 }
7221 }
7222
7223 STBIR__NEXT_PTR( vertical->contributors, vertical->contributors_size, stbir__contributors );
7224 STBIR__NEXT_PTR( vertical->coefficients, vertical->coefficients_size, float );
7225
7226 no_vert_alloc:
7227
7228 if ( info )
7229 {
7230 STBIR_PROFILE_BUILD_START( horizontal );
7231
7232 stbir__calculate_filters( horizontal, 0, user_data STBIR_ONLY_PROFILE_BUILD_SET_INFO );
7233
7234 // setup the horizontal gather functions
7235 // start with defaulting to the n_coeffs functions (specialized on channels and remnant leftover)
7236 info->horizontal_gather_channels = stbir__horizontal_gather_n_coeffs_funcs[ effective_channels ][ horizontal->extent_info.widest & 3 ];
7237 // but if the number of coeffs <= 12, use another set of special cases. <=12 coeffs is any enlarging resize, or shrinking resize down to about 1/3 size
7238 if ( horizontal->extent_info.widest <= 12 )
7239 info->horizontal_gather_channels = stbir__horizontal_gather_channels_funcs[ effective_channels ][ horizontal->extent_info.widest - 1 ];
7240
7241 info->scanline_extents.conservative.n0 = conservative->n0;
7242 info->scanline_extents.conservative.n1 = conservative->n1;
7243
7244 // get exact extents
7245 stbir__get_extents( horizontal, &info->scanline_extents );
7246
7247 // pack the horizontal coeffs
7248 horizontal->coefficient_width = stbir__pack_coefficients(horizontal->num_contributors, horizontal->contributors, horizontal->coefficients, horizontal->coefficient_width, horizontal->extent_info.widest, info->scanline_extents.conservative.n0, info->scanline_extents.conservative.n1 );
7249
7250 STBIR_MEMCPY( &info->horizontal, horizontal, sizeof( stbir__sampler ) );
7251
7252 STBIR_PROFILE_BUILD_END( horizontal );
7253
7254 if ( copy_horizontal )
7255 {
7256 STBIR_MEMCPY( &info->vertical, horizontal, sizeof( stbir__sampler ) );
7257 }
7258 else
7259 {
7260 STBIR_PROFILE_BUILD_START( vertical );
7261
7262 stbir__calculate_filters( vertical, possibly_use_horizontal_for_pivot, user_data STBIR_ONLY_PROFILE_BUILD_SET_INFO );
7263 STBIR_MEMCPY( &info->vertical, vertical, sizeof( stbir__sampler ) );
7264
7265 STBIR_PROFILE_BUILD_END( vertical );
7266 }
7267
7268 // setup the vertical split ranges
7269 stbir__get_split_info( info->split_info, info->splits, info->vertical.scale_info.output_sub_size, info->vertical.filter_pixel_margin, info->vertical.scale_info.input_full_size );
7270
7271 // now we know precisely how many entries we need
7272 info->ring_buffer_num_entries = info->vertical.extent_info.widest;
7273
7274 // we never need more ring buffer entries than the scanlines we're outputting
7275 if ( ( !info->vertical.is_gather ) && ( info->ring_buffer_num_entries > conservative_split_output_size ) )
7276 info->ring_buffer_num_entries = conservative_split_output_size;
7277 STBIR_ASSERT( info->ring_buffer_num_entries <= info->alloc_ring_buffer_num_entries );
7278 }
7279 #undef STBIR__NEXT_PTR
7280
7281
7282 // is this the first time through loop?
7283 if ( info == 0 )
7284 {
7285 alloced_total = ( 15 + (size_t)advance_mem );
7286 alloced = STBIR_MALLOC( alloced_total, user_data );
7287 if ( alloced == 0 )
7288 return 0;
7289 }
7290 else
7291 return info; // success
7292 }
7293}
7294
7295static int stbir__perform_resize( stbir__info const * info, int split_start, int split_count )
7296{
7297 stbir__per_split_info * split_info = info->split_info + split_start;
7298
7299 STBIR_PROFILE_CLEAR_EXTRAS();
7300
7301 STBIR_PROFILE_FIRST_START( looping );
7302 if (info->vertical.is_gather)
7303 stbir__vertical_gather_loop( info, split_info, split_count );
7304 else
7305 stbir__vertical_scatter_loop( info, split_info, split_count );
7306 STBIR_PROFILE_END( looping );
7307
7308 return 1;
7309}
7310
7311static void stbir__update_info_from_resize( stbir__info * info, STBIR_RESIZE * resize )
7312{
7313 static stbir__decode_pixels_func * decode_simple[STBIR_TYPE_HALF_FLOAT-STBIR_TYPE_UINT8_SRGB+1]=
7314 {
7315 /* 1ch-4ch */ stbir__decode_uint8_srgb, stbir__decode_uint8_srgb, 0, stbir__decode_float_linear, stbir__decode_half_float_linear,
7316 };
7317
7318 static stbir__decode_pixels_func * decode_alphas[STBIRI_AR-STBIRI_RGBA+1][STBIR_TYPE_HALF_FLOAT-STBIR_TYPE_UINT8_SRGB+1]=
7319 {
7320 { /* RGBA */ stbir__decode_uint8_srgb4_linearalpha, stbir__decode_uint8_srgb, 0, stbir__decode_float_linear, stbir__decode_half_float_linear },
7321 { /* BGRA */ stbir__decode_uint8_srgb4_linearalpha_BGRA, stbir__decode_uint8_srgb_BGRA, 0, stbir__decode_float_linear_BGRA, stbir__decode_half_float_linear_BGRA },
7322 { /* ARGB */ stbir__decode_uint8_srgb4_linearalpha_ARGB, stbir__decode_uint8_srgb_ARGB, 0, stbir__decode_float_linear_ARGB, stbir__decode_half_float_linear_ARGB },
7323 { /* ABGR */ stbir__decode_uint8_srgb4_linearalpha_ABGR, stbir__decode_uint8_srgb_ABGR, 0, stbir__decode_float_linear_ABGR, stbir__decode_half_float_linear_ABGR },
7324 { /* RA */ stbir__decode_uint8_srgb2_linearalpha, stbir__decode_uint8_srgb, 0, stbir__decode_float_linear, stbir__decode_half_float_linear },
7325 { /* AR */ stbir__decode_uint8_srgb2_linearalpha_AR, stbir__decode_uint8_srgb_AR, 0, stbir__decode_float_linear_AR, stbir__decode_half_float_linear_AR },
7326 };
7327
7328 static stbir__decode_pixels_func * decode_simple_scaled_or_not[2][2]=
7329 {
7330 { stbir__decode_uint8_linear_scaled, stbir__decode_uint8_linear }, { stbir__decode_uint16_linear_scaled, stbir__decode_uint16_linear },
7331 };
7332
7333 static stbir__decode_pixels_func * decode_alphas_scaled_or_not[STBIRI_AR-STBIRI_RGBA+1][2][2]=
7334 {
7335 { /* RGBA */ { stbir__decode_uint8_linear_scaled, stbir__decode_uint8_linear }, { stbir__decode_uint16_linear_scaled, stbir__decode_uint16_linear } },
7336 { /* BGRA */ { stbir__decode_uint8_linear_scaled_BGRA, stbir__decode_uint8_linear_BGRA }, { stbir__decode_uint16_linear_scaled_BGRA, stbir__decode_uint16_linear_BGRA } },
7337 { /* ARGB */ { stbir__decode_uint8_linear_scaled_ARGB, stbir__decode_uint8_linear_ARGB }, { stbir__decode_uint16_linear_scaled_ARGB, stbir__decode_uint16_linear_ARGB } },
7338 { /* ABGR */ { stbir__decode_uint8_linear_scaled_ABGR, stbir__decode_uint8_linear_ABGR }, { stbir__decode_uint16_linear_scaled_ABGR, stbir__decode_uint16_linear_ABGR } },
7339 { /* RA */ { stbir__decode_uint8_linear_scaled, stbir__decode_uint8_linear }, { stbir__decode_uint16_linear_scaled, stbir__decode_uint16_linear } },
7340 { /* AR */ { stbir__decode_uint8_linear_scaled_AR, stbir__decode_uint8_linear_AR }, { stbir__decode_uint16_linear_scaled_AR, stbir__decode_uint16_linear_AR } }
7341 };
7342
7343 static stbir__encode_pixels_func * encode_simple[STBIR_TYPE_HALF_FLOAT-STBIR_TYPE_UINT8_SRGB+1]=
7344 {
7345 /* 1ch-4ch */ stbir__encode_uint8_srgb, stbir__encode_uint8_srgb, 0, stbir__encode_float_linear, stbir__encode_half_float_linear,
7346 };
7347
7348 static stbir__encode_pixels_func * encode_alphas[STBIRI_AR-STBIRI_RGBA+1][STBIR_TYPE_HALF_FLOAT-STBIR_TYPE_UINT8_SRGB+1]=
7349 {
7350 { /* RGBA */ stbir__encode_uint8_srgb4_linearalpha, stbir__encode_uint8_srgb, 0, stbir__encode_float_linear, stbir__encode_half_float_linear },
7351 { /* BGRA */ stbir__encode_uint8_srgb4_linearalpha_BGRA, stbir__encode_uint8_srgb_BGRA, 0, stbir__encode_float_linear_BGRA, stbir__encode_half_float_linear_BGRA },
7352 { /* ARGB */ stbir__encode_uint8_srgb4_linearalpha_ARGB, stbir__encode_uint8_srgb_ARGB, 0, stbir__encode_float_linear_ARGB, stbir__encode_half_float_linear_ARGB },
7353 { /* ABGR */ stbir__encode_uint8_srgb4_linearalpha_ABGR, stbir__encode_uint8_srgb_ABGR, 0, stbir__encode_float_linear_ABGR, stbir__encode_half_float_linear_ABGR },
7354 { /* RA */ stbir__encode_uint8_srgb2_linearalpha, stbir__encode_uint8_srgb, 0, stbir__encode_float_linear, stbir__encode_half_float_linear },
7355 { /* AR */ stbir__encode_uint8_srgb2_linearalpha_AR, stbir__encode_uint8_srgb_AR, 0, stbir__encode_float_linear_AR, stbir__encode_half_float_linear_AR }
7356 };
7357
7358 static stbir__encode_pixels_func * encode_simple_scaled_or_not[2][2]=
7359 {
7360 { stbir__encode_uint8_linear_scaled, stbir__encode_uint8_linear }, { stbir__encode_uint16_linear_scaled, stbir__encode_uint16_linear },
7361 };
7362
7363 static stbir__encode_pixels_func * encode_alphas_scaled_or_not[STBIRI_AR-STBIRI_RGBA+1][2][2]=
7364 {
7365 { /* RGBA */ { stbir__encode_uint8_linear_scaled, stbir__encode_uint8_linear }, { stbir__encode_uint16_linear_scaled, stbir__encode_uint16_linear } },
7366 { /* BGRA */ { stbir__encode_uint8_linear_scaled_BGRA, stbir__encode_uint8_linear_BGRA }, { stbir__encode_uint16_linear_scaled_BGRA, stbir__encode_uint16_linear_BGRA } },
7367 { /* ARGB */ { stbir__encode_uint8_linear_scaled_ARGB, stbir__encode_uint8_linear_ARGB }, { stbir__encode_uint16_linear_scaled_ARGB, stbir__encode_uint16_linear_ARGB } },
7368 { /* ABGR */ { stbir__encode_uint8_linear_scaled_ABGR, stbir__encode_uint8_linear_ABGR }, { stbir__encode_uint16_linear_scaled_ABGR, stbir__encode_uint16_linear_ABGR } },
7369 { /* RA */ { stbir__encode_uint8_linear_scaled, stbir__encode_uint8_linear }, { stbir__encode_uint16_linear_scaled, stbir__encode_uint16_linear } },
7370 { /* AR */ { stbir__encode_uint8_linear_scaled_AR, stbir__encode_uint8_linear_AR }, { stbir__encode_uint16_linear_scaled_AR, stbir__encode_uint16_linear_AR } }
7371 };
7372
7373 stbir__decode_pixels_func * decode_pixels = 0;
7374 stbir__encode_pixels_func * encode_pixels = 0;
7375 stbir_datatype input_type, output_type;
7376
7377 input_type = resize->input_data_type;
7378 output_type = resize->output_data_type;
7379 info->input_data = resize->input_pixels;
7380 info->input_stride_bytes = resize->input_stride_in_bytes;
7381 info->output_stride_bytes = resize->output_stride_in_bytes;
7382
7383 // if we're completely point sampling, then we can turn off SRGB
7384 if ( ( info->horizontal.filter_enum == STBIR_FILTER_POINT_SAMPLE ) && ( info->vertical.filter_enum == STBIR_FILTER_POINT_SAMPLE ) )
7385 {
7386 if ( ( ( input_type == STBIR_TYPE_UINT8_SRGB ) || ( input_type == STBIR_TYPE_UINT8_SRGB_ALPHA ) ) &&
7387 ( ( output_type == STBIR_TYPE_UINT8_SRGB ) || ( output_type == STBIR_TYPE_UINT8_SRGB_ALPHA ) ) )
7388 {
7389 input_type = STBIR_TYPE_UINT8;
7390 output_type = STBIR_TYPE_UINT8;
7391 }
7392 }
7393
7394 // recalc the output and input strides
7395 if ( info->input_stride_bytes == 0 )
7396 info->input_stride_bytes = info->channels * info->horizontal.scale_info.input_full_size * stbir__type_size[input_type];
7397
7398 if ( info->output_stride_bytes == 0 )
7399 info->output_stride_bytes = info->channels * info->horizontal.scale_info.output_sub_size * stbir__type_size[output_type];
7400
7401 // calc offset
7402 info->output_data = ( (char*) resize->output_pixels ) + ( (size_t) info->offset_y * (size_t) resize->output_stride_in_bytes ) + ( info->offset_x * info->channels * stbir__type_size[output_type] );
7403
7404 info->in_pixels_cb = resize->input_cb;
7405 info->user_data = resize->user_data;
7406 info->out_pixels_cb = resize->output_cb;
7407
7408 // setup the input format converters
7409 if ( ( input_type == STBIR_TYPE_UINT8 ) || ( input_type == STBIR_TYPE_UINT16 ) )
7410 {
7411 int non_scaled = 0;
7412
7413 // check if we can run unscaled - 0-255.0/0-65535.0 instead of 0-1.0 (which is a tiny bit faster when doing linear 8->8 or 16->16)
7414 if ( ( !info->alpha_weight ) && ( !info->alpha_unweight ) ) // don't short circuit when alpha weighting (get everything to 0-1.0 as usual)
7415 if ( ( ( input_type == STBIR_TYPE_UINT8 ) && ( output_type == STBIR_TYPE_UINT8 ) ) || ( ( input_type == STBIR_TYPE_UINT16 ) && ( output_type == STBIR_TYPE_UINT16 ) ) )
7416 non_scaled = 1;
7417
7418 if ( info->input_pixel_layout_internal <= STBIRI_4CHANNEL )
7419 decode_pixels = decode_simple_scaled_or_not[ input_type == STBIR_TYPE_UINT16 ][ non_scaled ];
7420 else
7421 decode_pixels = decode_alphas_scaled_or_not[ ( info->input_pixel_layout_internal - STBIRI_RGBA ) % ( STBIRI_AR-STBIRI_RGBA+1 ) ][ input_type == STBIR_TYPE_UINT16 ][ non_scaled ];
7422 }
7423 else
7424 {
7425 if ( info->input_pixel_layout_internal <= STBIRI_4CHANNEL )
7426 decode_pixels = decode_simple[ input_type - STBIR_TYPE_UINT8_SRGB ];
7427 else
7428 decode_pixels = decode_alphas[ ( info->input_pixel_layout_internal - STBIRI_RGBA ) % ( STBIRI_AR-STBIRI_RGBA+1 ) ][ input_type - STBIR_TYPE_UINT8_SRGB ];
7429 }
7430
7431 // setup the output format converters
7432 if ( ( output_type == STBIR_TYPE_UINT8 ) || ( output_type == STBIR_TYPE_UINT16 ) )
7433 {
7434 int non_scaled = 0;
7435
7436 // check if we can run unscaled - 0-255.0/0-65535.0 instead of 0-1.0 (which is a tiny bit faster when doing linear 8->8 or 16->16)
7437 if ( ( !info->alpha_weight ) && ( !info->alpha_unweight ) ) // don't short circuit when alpha weighting (get everything to 0-1.0 as usual)
7438 if ( ( ( input_type == STBIR_TYPE_UINT8 ) && ( output_type == STBIR_TYPE_UINT8 ) ) || ( ( input_type == STBIR_TYPE_UINT16 ) && ( output_type == STBIR_TYPE_UINT16 ) ) )
7439 non_scaled = 1;
7440
7441 if ( info->output_pixel_layout_internal <= STBIRI_4CHANNEL )
7442 encode_pixels = encode_simple_scaled_or_not[ output_type == STBIR_TYPE_UINT16 ][ non_scaled ];
7443 else
7444 encode_pixels = encode_alphas_scaled_or_not[ ( info->output_pixel_layout_internal - STBIRI_RGBA ) % ( STBIRI_AR-STBIRI_RGBA+1 ) ][ output_type == STBIR_TYPE_UINT16 ][ non_scaled ];
7445 }
7446 else
7447 {
7448 if ( info->output_pixel_layout_internal <= STBIRI_4CHANNEL )
7449 encode_pixels = encode_simple[ output_type - STBIR_TYPE_UINT8_SRGB ];
7450 else
7451 encode_pixels = encode_alphas[ ( info->output_pixel_layout_internal - STBIRI_RGBA ) % ( STBIRI_AR-STBIRI_RGBA+1 ) ][ output_type - STBIR_TYPE_UINT8_SRGB ];
7452 }
7453
7454 info->input_type = input_type;
7455 info->output_type = output_type;
7456 info->decode_pixels = decode_pixels;
7457 info->encode_pixels = encode_pixels;
7458}
7459
7460static void stbir__clip( int * outx, int * outsubw, int outw, double * u0, double * u1 )
7461{
7462 double per, adj;
7463 int over;
7464
7465 // do left/top edge
7466 if ( *outx < 0 )
7467 {
7468 per = ( (double)*outx ) / ( (double)*outsubw ); // is negative
7469 adj = per * ( *u1 - *u0 );
7470 *u0 -= adj; // increases u0
7471 *outx = 0;
7472 }
7473
7474 // do right/bot edge
7475 over = outw - ( *outx + *outsubw );
7476 if ( over < 0 )
7477 {
7478 per = ( (double)over ) / ( (double)*outsubw ); // is negative
7479 adj = per * ( *u1 - *u0 );
7480 *u1 += adj; // decrease u1
7481 *outsubw = outw - *outx;
7482 }
7483}
7484
7485// converts a double to a rational that has less than one float bit of error (returns 0 if unable to do so)
7486static int stbir__double_to_rational(double f, stbir_uint32 limit, stbir_uint32 *numer, stbir_uint32 *denom, int limit_denom ) // limit_denom (1) or limit numer (0)
7487{
7488 double err;
7489 stbir_uint64 top, bot;
7490 stbir_uint64 numer_last = 0;
7491 stbir_uint64 denom_last = 1;
7492 stbir_uint64 numer_estimate = 1;
7493 stbir_uint64 denom_estimate = 0;
7494
7495 // scale to past float error range
7496 top = (stbir_uint64)( f * (double)(1 << 25) );
7497 bot = 1 << 25;
7498
7499 // keep refining, but usually stops in a few loops - usually 5 for bad cases
7500 for(;;)
7501 {
7502 stbir_uint64 est, temp;
7503
7504 // hit limit, break out and do best full range estimate
7505 if ( ( ( limit_denom ) ? denom_estimate : numer_estimate ) >= limit )
7506 break;
7507
7508 // is the current error less than 1 bit of a float? if so, we're done
7509 if ( denom_estimate )
7510 {
7511 err = ( (double)numer_estimate / (double)denom_estimate ) - f;
7512 if ( err < 0.0 ) err = -err;
7513 if ( err < ( 1.0 / (double)(1<<24) ) )
7514 {
7515 // yup, found it
7516 *numer = (stbir_uint32) numer_estimate;
7517 *denom = (stbir_uint32) denom_estimate;
7518 return 1;
7519 }
7520 }
7521
7522 // no more refinement bits left? break out and do full range estimate
7523 if ( bot == 0 )
7524 break;
7525
7526 // gcd the estimate bits
7527 est = top / bot;
7528 temp = top % bot;
7529 top = bot;
7530 bot = temp;
7531
7532 // move remainders
7533 temp = est * denom_estimate + denom_last;
7534 denom_last = denom_estimate;
7535 denom_estimate = temp;
7536
7537 // move remainders
7538 temp = est * numer_estimate + numer_last;
7539 numer_last = numer_estimate;
7540 numer_estimate = temp;
7541 }
7542
7543 // we didn't fine anything good enough for float, use a full range estimate
7544 if ( limit_denom )
7545 {
7546 numer_estimate= (stbir_uint64)( f * (double)limit + 0.5 );
7547 denom_estimate = limit;
7548 }
7549 else
7550 {
7551 numer_estimate = limit;
7552 denom_estimate = (stbir_uint64)( ( (double)limit / f ) + 0.5 );
7553 }
7554
7555 *numer = (stbir_uint32) numer_estimate;
7556 *denom = (stbir_uint32) denom_estimate;
7557
7558 err = ( denom_estimate ) ? ( ( (double)(stbir_uint32)numer_estimate / (double)(stbir_uint32)denom_estimate ) - f ) : 1.0;
7559 if ( err < 0.0 ) err = -err;
7560 return ( err < ( 1.0 / (double)(1<<24) ) ) ? 1 : 0;
7561}
7562
7563static int stbir__calculate_region_transform( stbir__scale_info * scale_info, int output_full_range, int * output_offset, int output_sub_range, int input_full_range, double input_s0, double input_s1 )
7564{
7565 double output_range, input_range, output_s, input_s, ratio, scale;
7566
7567 input_s = input_s1 - input_s0;
7568
7569 // null area
7570 if ( ( output_full_range == 0 ) || ( input_full_range == 0 ) ||
7571 ( output_sub_range == 0 ) || ( input_s <= stbir__small_float ) )
7572 return 0;
7573
7574 // are either of the ranges completely out of bounds?
7575 if ( ( *output_offset >= output_full_range ) || ( ( *output_offset + output_sub_range ) <= 0 ) || ( input_s0 >= (1.0f-stbir__small_float) ) || ( input_s1 <= stbir__small_float ) )
7576 return 0;
7577
7578 output_range = (double)output_full_range;
7579 input_range = (double)input_full_range;
7580
7581 output_s = ( (double)output_sub_range) / output_range;
7582
7583 // figure out the scaling to use
7584 ratio = output_s / input_s;
7585
7586 // save scale before clipping
7587 scale = ( output_range / input_range ) * ratio;
7588 scale_info->scale = (float)scale;
7589 scale_info->inv_scale = (float)( 1.0 / scale );
7590
7591 // clip output area to left/right output edges (and adjust input area)
7592 stbir__clip( output_offset, &output_sub_range, output_full_range, &input_s0, &input_s1 );
7593
7594 // recalc input area
7595 input_s = input_s1 - input_s0;
7596
7597 // after clipping do we have zero input area?
7598 if ( input_s <= stbir__small_float )
7599 return 0;
7600
7601 // calculate and store the starting source offsets in output pixel space
7602 scale_info->pixel_shift = (float) ( input_s0 * ratio * output_range );
7603
7604 scale_info->scale_is_rational = stbir__double_to_rational( scale, ( scale <= 1.0 ) ? output_full_range : input_full_range, &scale_info->scale_numerator, &scale_info->scale_denominator, ( scale >= 1.0 ) );
7605
7606 scale_info->input_full_size = input_full_range;
7607 scale_info->output_sub_size = output_sub_range;
7608
7609 return 1;
7610}

7613static void stbir__init_and_set_layout( STBIR_RESIZE * resize, stbir_pixel_layout pixel_layout, stbir_datatype data_type )
7614{
7615 resize->input_cb = 0;
7616 resize->output_cb = 0;
7617 resize->user_data = resize;
7618 resize->samplers = 0;
7619 resize->called_alloc = 0;
7620 resize->horizontal_filter = STBIR_FILTER_DEFAULT;
7621 resize->horizontal_filter_kernel = 0; resize->horizontal_filter_support = 0;
7622 resize->vertical_filter = STBIR_FILTER_DEFAULT;
7623 resize->vertical_filter_kernel = 0; resize->vertical_filter_support = 0;
7624 resize->horizontal_edge = STBIR_EDGE_CLAMP;
7625 resize->vertical_edge = STBIR_EDGE_CLAMP;
7626 resize->input_s0 = 0; resize->input_t0 = 0; resize->input_s1 = 1; resize->input_t1 = 1;
7627 resize->output_subx = 0; resize->output_suby = 0; resize->output_subw = resize->output_w; resize->output_subh = resize->output_h;
7628 resize->input_data_type = data_type;
7629 resize->output_data_type = data_type;
7630 resize->input_pixel_layout_public = pixel_layout;
7631 resize->output_pixel_layout_public = pixel_layout;
7632 resize->needs_rebuild = 1;
7633}

7732STBIRDEF int stbir_set_input_subrect( STBIR_RESIZE * resize, double s0, double t0, double s1, double t1 ) // sets input region (full region by default)
7733{
7734 resize->input_s0 = s0;
7735 resize->input_t0 = t0;
7736 resize->input_s1 = s1;
7737 resize->input_t1 = t1;
7738 resize->needs_rebuild = 1;
7739
7740 // are we inbounds?
7741 if ( ( s1 < stbir__small_float ) || ( (s1-s0) < stbir__small_float ) ||
7742 ( t1 < stbir__small_float ) || ( (t1-t0) < stbir__small_float ) ||
7743 ( s0 > (1.0f-stbir__small_float) ) ||
7744 ( t0 > (1.0f-stbir__small_float) ) )
7745 return 0;
7746
7747 return 1;
7748}

7750STBIRDEF int stbir_set_output_pixel_subrect( STBIR_RESIZE * resize, int subx, int suby, int subw, int subh ) // sets input region (full region by default)
7751{
7752 resize->output_subx = subx;
7753 resize->output_suby = suby;
7754 resize->output_subw = subw;
7755 resize->output_subh = subh;
7756 resize->needs_rebuild = 1;
7757
7758 // are we inbounds?
7759 if ( ( subx >= resize->output_w ) || ( ( subx + subw ) <= 0 ) || ( suby >= resize->output_h ) || ( ( suby + subh ) <= 0 ) || ( subw == 0 ) || ( subh == 0 ) )
7760 return 0;
7761
7762 return 1;
7763}
7764
7765STBIRDEF int stbir_set_pixel_subrect( STBIR_RESIZE * resize, int subx, int suby, int subw, int subh ) // sets both regions (full regions by default)
7766{
7767 double s0, t0, s1, t1;
7768
7769 s0 = ( (double)subx ) / ( (double)resize->output_w );
7770 t0 = ( (double)suby ) / ( (double)resize->output_h );
7771 s1 = ( (double)(subx+subw) ) / ( (double)resize->output_w );
7772 t1 = ( (double)(suby+subh) ) / ( (double)resize->output_h );
7773
7774 resize->input_s0 = s0;
7775 resize->input_t0 = t0;
7776 resize->input_s1 = s1;
7777 resize->input_t1 = t1;
7778 resize->output_subx = subx;
7779 resize->output_suby = suby;
7780 resize->output_subw = subw;
7781 resize->output_subh = subh;
7782 resize->needs_rebuild = 1;
7783
7784 // are we inbounds?
7785 if ( ( subx >= resize->output_w ) || ( ( subx + subw ) <= 0 ) || ( suby >= resize->output_h ) || ( ( suby + subh ) <= 0 ) || ( subw == 0 ) || ( subh == 0 ) )
7786 return 0;
7787
7788 return 1;
7789}
7790
7791static int stbir__perform_build( STBIR_RESIZE * resize, int splits )
7792{
7793 stbir__contributors conservative = { 0, 0 };
7794 stbir__sampler horizontal, vertical;
7795 int new_output_subx, new_output_suby;
7796 stbir__info * out_info;
7797 #ifdef STBIR_PROFILE
7798 stbir__info profile_infod; // used to contain building profile info before everything is allocated
7799 stbir__info * profile_info = &profile_infod;
7800 #endif
7801
7802 // have we already built the samplers?
7803 if ( resize->samplers )
7804 return 0;
7805
7806 #define STBIR_RETURN_ERROR_AND_ASSERT( exp ) STBIR_ASSERT( !(exp) ); if (exp) return 0;
7807 STBIR_RETURN_ERROR_AND_ASSERT( (unsigned)resize->horizontal_filter >= STBIR_FILTER_OTHER)
7808 STBIR_RETURN_ERROR_AND_ASSERT( (unsigned)resize->vertical_filter >= STBIR_FILTER_OTHER)
7809 #undef STBIR_RETURN_ERROR_AND_ASSERT
7810
7811 if ( splits <= 0 )
7812 return 0;
7813
7814 STBIR_PROFILE_BUILD_FIRST_START( build );
7815
7816 new_output_subx = resize->output_subx;
7817 new_output_suby = resize->output_suby;
7818
7819 // do horizontal clip and scale calcs
7820 if ( !stbir__calculate_region_transform( &horizontal.scale_info, resize->output_w, &new_output_subx, resize->output_subw, resize->input_w, resize->input_s0, resize->input_s1 ) )
7821 return 0;
7822
7823 // do vertical clip and scale calcs
7824 if ( !stbir__calculate_region_transform( &vertical.scale_info, resize->output_h, &new_output_suby, resize->output_subh, resize->input_h, resize->input_t0, resize->input_t1 ) )
7825 return 0;
7826
7827 // if nothing to do, just return
7828 if ( ( horizontal.scale_info.output_sub_size == 0 ) || ( vertical.scale_info.output_sub_size == 0 ) )
7829 return 0;
7830
7831 stbir__set_sampler(&horizontal, resize->horizontal_filter, resize->horizontal_filter_kernel, resize->horizontal_filter_support, resize->horizontal_edge, &horizontal.scale_info, 1, resize->user_data );
7832 stbir__get_conservative_extents( &horizontal, &conservative, resize->user_data );
7833 stbir__set_sampler(&vertical, resize->vertical_filter, resize->horizontal_filter_kernel, resize->vertical_filter_support, resize->vertical_edge, &vertical.scale_info, 0, resize->user_data );
7834
7835 if ( ( vertical.scale_info.output_sub_size / splits ) < STBIR_FORCE_MINIMUM_SCANLINES_FOR_SPLITS ) // each split should be a minimum of 4 scanlines (handwavey choice)
7836 {
7837 splits = vertical.scale_info.output_sub_size / STBIR_FORCE_MINIMUM_SCANLINES_FOR_SPLITS;
7838 if ( splits == 0 ) splits = 1;
7839 }
7840
7841 STBIR_PROFILE_BUILD_START( alloc );
7842 out_info = stbir__alloc_internal_mem_and_build_samplers( &horizontal, &vertical, &conservative, resize->input_pixel_layout_public, resize->output_pixel_layout_public, splits, new_output_subx, new_output_suby, resize->fast_alpha, resize->user_data STBIR_ONLY_PROFILE_BUILD_SET_INFO );
7843 STBIR_PROFILE_BUILD_END( alloc );
7844 STBIR_PROFILE_BUILD_END( build );
7845
7846 if ( out_info )
7847 {
7848 resize->splits = splits;
7849 resize->samplers = out_info;
7850 resize->needs_rebuild = 0;
7851 #ifdef STBIR_PROFILE
7852 STBIR_MEMCPY( &out_info->profile, &profile_infod.profile, sizeof( out_info->profile ) );
7853 #endif
7854
7855 // update anything that can be changed without recalcing samplers
7856 stbir__update_info_from_resize( out_info, resize );
7857
7858 return splits;
7859 }
7860
7861 return 0;
7862}
7863
7864void stbir_free_samplers( STBIR_RESIZE * resize )
7865{
7866 if ( resize->samplers )
7867 {
7868 stbir__free_internal_mem( resize->samplers );
7869 resize->samplers = 0;
7870 resize->called_alloc = 0;
7871 }
7872}
7873
7874STBIRDEF int stbir_build_samplers_with_splits( STBIR_RESIZE * resize, int splits )
7875{
7876 if ( ( resize->samplers == 0 ) || ( resize->needs_rebuild ) )
7877 {
7878 if ( resize->samplers )
7879 stbir_free_samplers( resize );
7880
7881 resize->called_alloc = 1;
7882 return stbir__perform_build( resize, splits );
7883 }
7884
7885 STBIR_PROFILE_BUILD_CLEAR( resize->samplers );
7886
7887 return 1;
7888}
7889
7890STBIRDEF int stbir_build_samplers( STBIR_RESIZE * resize )
7891{
7892 return stbir_build_samplers_with_splits( resize, 1 );
7893}
7894
7895STBIRDEF int stbir_resize_extended( STBIR_RESIZE * resize )
7896{
7897 int result;
7898
7899 if ( ( resize->samplers == 0 ) || ( resize->needs_rebuild ) )
7900 {
7901 int alloc_state = resize->called_alloc; // remember allocated state
7902
7903 if ( resize->samplers )
7904 {
7905 stbir__free_internal_mem( resize->samplers );
7906 resize->samplers = 0;
7907 }
7908
7909 if ( !stbir_build_samplers( resize ) )
7910 return 0;
7911
7912 resize->called_alloc = alloc_state;
7913
7914 // if build_samplers succeeded (above), but there are no samplers set, then
7915 // the area to stretch into was zero pixels, so don't do anything and return
7916 // success
7917 if ( resize->samplers == 0 )
7918 return 1;
7919 }
7920 else
7921 {
7922 // didn't build anything - clear it
7923 STBIR_PROFILE_BUILD_CLEAR( resize->samplers );
7924 }
7925
7926 // do resize
7927 result = stbir__perform_resize( resize->samplers, 0, resize->splits );
7928
7929 // if we alloced, then free
7930 if ( !resize->called_alloc )
7931 {
7932 stbir_free_samplers( resize );
7933 resize->samplers = 0;
7934 }
7935
7936 return result;
7937}
7938
7939STBIRDEF int stbir_resize_extended_split( STBIR_RESIZE * resize, int split_start, int split_count )
7940{
7941 STBIR_ASSERT( resize->samplers );
7942
7943 // if we're just doing the whole thing, call full
7944 if ( ( split_start == -1 ) || ( ( split_start == 0 ) && ( split_count == resize->splits ) ) )
7945 return stbir_resize_extended( resize );
7946
7947 // you **must** build samplers first when using split resize
7948 if ( ( resize->samplers == 0 ) || ( resize->needs_rebuild ) )
7949 return 0;
7950
7951 if ( ( split_start >= resize->splits ) || ( split_start < 0 ) || ( ( split_start + split_count ) > resize->splits ) || ( split_count <= 0 ) )
7952 return 0;
7953
7954 // do resize
7955 return stbir__perform_resize( resize->samplers, split_start, split_count );
7956}
7957
7958static int stbir__check_output_stuff( void ** ret_ptr, int * ret_pitch, void * output_pixels, int type_size, int output_w, int output_h, int output_stride_in_bytes, stbir_internal_pixel_layout pixel_layout )
7959{
7960 size_t size;
7961 int pitch;
7962 void * ptr;
7963
7964 pitch = output_w * type_size * stbir__pixel_channels[ pixel_layout ];
7965 if ( pitch == 0 )
7966 return 0;
7967
7968 if ( output_stride_in_bytes == 0 )
7969 output_stride_in_bytes = pitch;
7970
7971 if ( output_stride_in_bytes < pitch )
7972 return 0;
7973
7974 size = (size_t)output_stride_in_bytes * (size_t)output_h;
7975 if ( size == 0 )
7976 return 0;
7977
7978 *ret_ptr = 0;
7979 *ret_pitch = output_stride_in_bytes;
7980
7981 if ( output_pixels == 0 )
7982 {
7983 ptr = STBIR_MALLOC( size, 0 );
7984 if ( ptr == 0 )
7985 return 0;
7986
7987 *ret_ptr = ptr;
7988 *ret_pitch = pitch;
7989 }
7990
7991 return 1;
7992}

7995STBIRDEF unsigned char * stbir_resize_uint8_linear( const unsigned char *input_pixels , int input_w , int input_h, int input_stride_in_bytes,
7996 unsigned char *output_pixels, int output_w, int output_h, int output_stride_in_bytes,
7997 stbir_pixel_layout pixel_layout )
7998{
7999 STBIR_RESIZE resize;
8000 unsigned char * optr;
8001 int opitch;
8002
8003 if ( !stbir__check_output_stuff( (void**)&optr, &opitch, output_pixels, sizeof( unsigned char ), output_w, output_h, output_stride_in_bytes, stbir__pixel_layout_convert_public_to_internal[ pixel_layout ] ) )
8004 return 0;
8005
8006 stbir_resize_init( &resize,
8007 input_pixels, input_w, input_h, input_stride_in_bytes,
8008 (optr) ? optr : output_pixels, output_w, output_h, opitch,
8009 pixel_layout, STBIR_TYPE_UINT8 );
8010
8011 if ( !stbir_resize_extended( &resize ) )
8012 {
8013 if ( optr )
8014 STBIR_FREE( optr, 0 );
8015 return 0;
8016 }
8017
8018 return (optr) ? optr : output_pixels;
8019}

8030 return 0;

8047
8048STBIRDEF float * stbir_resize_float_linear( const float *input_pixels , int input_w , int input_h, int input_stride_in_bytes,
8049 float *output_pixels, int output_w, int output_h, int output_stride_in_bytes,
8050 stbir_pixel_layout pixel_layout )
8051{
8052 STBIR_RESIZE resize;
8053 float * optr;
8054 int opitch;
8055
8056 if ( !stbir__check_output_stuff( (void**)&optr, &opitch, output_pixels, sizeof( float ), output_w, output_h, output_stride_in_bytes, stbir__pixel_layout_convert_public_to_internal[ pixel_layout ] ) )
8057 return 0;
8058
8059 stbir_resize_init( &resize,
8060 input_pixels, input_w, input_h, input_stride_in_bytes,
8061 (optr) ? optr : output_pixels, output_w, output_h, opitch,
8062 pixel_layout, STBIR_TYPE_FLOAT );
8063
8064 if ( !stbir_resize_extended( &resize ) )
8065 {
8066 if ( optr )
8067 STBIR_FREE( optr, 0 );
8068 return 0;
8069 }
8070
8071 return (optr) ? optr : output_pixels;
8072}

8074
8075STBIRDEF void * stbir_resize( const void *input_pixels , int input_w , int input_h, int input_stride_in_bytes,
8076 void *output_pixels, int output_w, int output_h, int output_stride_in_bytes,
8077 stbir_pixel_layout pixel_layout, stbir_datatype data_type,
8078 stbir_edge edge, stbir_filter filter )
8079{
8080 STBIR_RESIZE resize;
8081 float * optr;
8082 int opitch;
8083
8084 if ( !stbir__check_output_stuff( (void**)&optr, &opitch, output_pixels, stbir__type_size[data_type], output_w, output_h, output_stride_in_bytes, stbir__pixel_layout_convert_public_to_internal[ pixel_layout ] ) )
8085 return 0;
8086
8087 stbir_resize_init( &resize,
8088 input_pixels, input_w, input_h, input_stride_in_bytes,
8089 (optr) ? optr : output_pixels, output_w, output_h, output_stride_in_bytes,
8090 pixel_layout, data_type );
8091
8092 resize.horizontal_edge = edge;
8093 resize.vertical_edge = edge;
8094 resize.horizontal_filter = filter;
8095 resize.vertical_filter = filter;
8096
8097 if ( !stbir_resize_extended( &resize ) )
8098 {
8099 if ( optr )
8100 STBIR_FREE( optr, 0 );
8101 return 0;
8102 }
8103
8104 return (optr) ? optr : output_pixels;
8105}
