8109STBIRDEF void stbir_resize_build_profile_info( STBIR_PROFILE_INFO * info, STBIR_RESIZE const * resize )
8110{
8111 static char const * bdescriptions[6] = { "Building", "Allocating", "Horizontal sampler", "Vertical sampler", "Coefficient cleanup", "Coefficient piovot" } ;
8112 stbir__info* samp = resize->samplers;
8113 int i;
8114
8115 typedef int testa[ (STBIR__ARRAY_SIZE( bdescriptions ) == (STBIR__ARRAY_SIZE( samp->profile.array )-1) )?1:-1];
8116 typedef int testb[ (sizeof( samp->profile.array ) == (sizeof(samp->profile.named)) )?1:-1];
8117 typedef int testc[ (sizeof( info->clocks ) >= (sizeof(samp->profile.named)) )?1:-1];
8118
8119 for( i = 0 ; i < STBIR__ARRAY_SIZE( bdescriptions ) ; i++)
8120 info->clocks[i] = samp->profile.array[i+1];
8121
8122 info->total_clocks = samp->profile.named.total;
8123 info->descriptions = bdescriptions;
8124 info->count = STBIR__ARRAY_SIZE( bdescriptions );
8125}
8126
8127STBIRDEF void stbir_resize_split_profile_info( STBIR_PROFILE_INFO * info, STBIR_RESIZE const * resize, int split_start, int split_count )
8128{
8129 static char const * descriptions[7] = { "Looping", "Vertical sampling", "Horizontal sampling", "Scanline input", "Scanline output", "Alpha weighting", "Alpha unweighting" };
8130 stbir__per_split_info * split_info;
8131 int s, i;
8132
8133 typedef int testa[ (STBIR__ARRAY_SIZE( descriptions ) == (STBIR__ARRAY_SIZE( split_info->profile.array )-1) )?1:-1];
8134 typedef int testb[ (sizeof( split_info->profile.array ) == (sizeof(split_info->profile.named)) )?1:-1];
8135 typedef int testc[ (sizeof( info->clocks ) >= (sizeof(split_info->profile.named)) )?1:-1];
8136
8137 if ( split_start == -1 )
8138 {
8139 split_start = 0;
8140 split_count = resize->samplers->splits;
8141 }
8142
8143 if ( ( split_start >= resize->splits ) || ( split_start < 0 ) || ( ( split_start + split_count ) > resize->splits ) || ( split_count <= 0 ) )
8144 {
8145 info->total_clocks = 0;
8146 info->descriptions = 0;
8147 info->count = 0;
8148 return;
8149 }
8150
8151 split_info = resize->samplers->split_info + split_start;
8152
8153 // sum up the profile from all the splits
8154 for( i = 0 ; i < STBIR__ARRAY_SIZE( descriptions ) ; i++ )
8155 {
8156 stbir_uint64 sum = 0;
8157 for( s = 0 ; s < split_count ; s++ )
8158 sum += split_info[s].profile.array[i+1];
8159 info->clocks[i] = sum;
8160 }
8161
8162 info->total_clocks = split_info->profile.named.total;
8163 info->descriptions = descriptions;
8164 info->count = STBIR__ARRAY_SIZE( descriptions );
8165}
8166
8167STBIRDEF void stbir_resize_extended_profile_info( STBIR_PROFILE_INFO * info, STBIR_RESIZE const * resize )
8168{
8169 stbir_resize_split_profile_info( info, resize, -1, 0 );
8170}

8241static float * STBIR__CODER_NAME( stbir__decode_uint8_linear_scaled )( float * decodep, int width_times_channels, void const * inputp )
8242{
8243 float STBIR_STREAMOUT_PTR( * ) decode = decodep;
8244 float * decode_end = (float*) decode + width_times_channels;
8245 unsigned char const * input = (unsigned char const*)inputp;
8246
8247 #ifdef STBIR_SIMD
8248 unsigned char const * end_input_m16 = input + width_times_channels - 16;
8249 if ( width_times_channels >= 16 )
8250 {
8251 decode_end -= 16;
8252 STBIR_NO_UNROLL_LOOP_START_INF_FOR
8253 for(;;)
8254 {
8255 #ifdef STBIR_SIMD8
8256 stbir__simdi i; stbir__simdi8 o0,o1;
8257 stbir__simdf8 of0, of1;
8258 STBIR_NO_UNROLL(decode);
8259 stbir__simdi_load( i, input );
8260 stbir__simdi8_expand_u8_to_u32( o0, o1, i );
8261 stbir__simdi8_convert_i32_to_float( of0, o0 );
8262 stbir__simdi8_convert_i32_to_float( of1, o1 );
8263 stbir__simdf8_mult( of0, of0, STBIR_max_uint8_as_float_inverted8);
8264 stbir__simdf8_mult( of1, of1, STBIR_max_uint8_as_float_inverted8);
8265 stbir__decode_simdf8_flip( of0 );
8266 stbir__decode_simdf8_flip( of1 );
8267 stbir__simdf8_store( decode + 0, of0 );
8268 stbir__simdf8_store( decode + 8, of1 );
8269 #else
8270 stbir__simdi i, o0, o1, o2, o3;
8271 stbir__simdf of0, of1, of2, of3;
8272 STBIR_NO_UNROLL(decode);
8273 stbir__simdi_load( i, input );
8274 stbir__simdi_expand_u8_to_u32( o0,o1,o2,o3,i);
8275 stbir__simdi_convert_i32_to_float( of0, o0 );
8276 stbir__simdi_convert_i32_to_float( of1, o1 );
8277 stbir__simdi_convert_i32_to_float( of2, o2 );
8278 stbir__simdi_convert_i32_to_float( of3, o3 );
8279 stbir__simdf_mult( of0, of0, STBIR__CONSTF(STBIR_max_uint8_as_float_inverted) );
8280 stbir__simdf_mult( of1, of1, STBIR__CONSTF(STBIR_max_uint8_as_float_inverted) );
8281 stbir__simdf_mult( of2, of2, STBIR__CONSTF(STBIR_max_uint8_as_float_inverted) );
8282 stbir__simdf_mult( of3, of3, STBIR__CONSTF(STBIR_max_uint8_as_float_inverted) );
8283 stbir__decode_simdf4_flip( of0 );
8284 stbir__decode_simdf4_flip( of1 );
8285 stbir__decode_simdf4_flip( of2 );
8286 stbir__decode_simdf4_flip( of3 );
8287 stbir__simdf_store( decode + 0, of0 );
8288 stbir__simdf_store( decode + 4, of1 );
8289 stbir__simdf_store( decode + 8, of2 );
8290 stbir__simdf_store( decode + 12, of3 );
8291 #endif
8292 decode += 16;
8293 input += 16;
8294 if ( decode <= decode_end )
8295 continue;
8296 if ( decode == ( decode_end + 16 ) )
8297 break;
8298 decode = decode_end; // backup and do last couple
8299 input = end_input_m16;
8300 }
8301 return decode_end + 16;
8302 }
8303 #endif
8304
8305 // try to do blocks of 4 when you can
8306 #if stbir__coder_min_num != 3 // doesn't divide cleanly by four
8307 decode += 4;
8308 STBIR_SIMD_NO_UNROLL_LOOP_START
8309 while( decode <= decode_end )
8310 {
8311 STBIR_SIMD_NO_UNROLL(decode);
8312 decode[0-4] = ((float)(input[stbir__decode_order0])) * stbir__max_uint8_as_float_inverted;
8313 decode[1-4] = ((float)(input[stbir__decode_order1])) * stbir__max_uint8_as_float_inverted;
8314 decode[2-4] = ((float)(input[stbir__decode_order2])) * stbir__max_uint8_as_float_inverted;
8315 decode[3-4] = ((float)(input[stbir__decode_order3])) * stbir__max_uint8_as_float_inverted;
8316 decode += 4;
8317 input += 4;
8318 }
8319 decode -= 4;
8320 #endif
8321
8322 // do the remnants
8323 #if stbir__coder_min_num < 4
8324 STBIR_NO_UNROLL_LOOP_START
8325 while( decode < decode_end )
8326 {
8327 STBIR_NO_UNROLL(decode);
8328 decode[0] = ((float)(input[stbir__decode_order0])) * stbir__max_uint8_as_float_inverted;
8329 #if stbir__coder_min_num >= 2
8330 decode[1] = ((float)(input[stbir__decode_order1])) * stbir__max_uint8_as_float_inverted;
8331 #endif
8332 #if stbir__coder_min_num >= 3
8333 decode[2] = ((float)(input[stbir__decode_order2])) * stbir__max_uint8_as_float_inverted;
8334 #endif
8335 decode += stbir__coder_min_num;
8336 input += stbir__coder_min_num;
8337 }
8338 #endif
8339
8340 return decode_end;
8341}

8343static void STBIR__CODER_NAME( stbir__encode_uint8_linear_scaled )( void * outputp, int width_times_channels, float const * encode )
8344{
8345 unsigned char STBIR_SIMD_STREAMOUT_PTR( * ) output = (unsigned char *) outputp;
8346 unsigned char * end_output = ( (unsigned char *) output ) + width_times_channels;
8347
8348 #ifdef STBIR_SIMD
8349 if ( width_times_channels >= stbir__simdfX_float_count*2 )
8350 {
8351 float const * end_encode_m8 = encode + width_times_channels - stbir__simdfX_float_count*2;
8352 end_output -= stbir__simdfX_float_count*2;
8353 STBIR_NO_UNROLL_LOOP_START_INF_FOR
8354 for(;;)
8355 {
8356 stbir__simdfX e0, e1;
8357 stbir__simdi i;
8358 STBIR_SIMD_NO_UNROLL(encode);
8359 stbir__simdfX_madd_mem( e0, STBIR_simd_point5X, STBIR_max_uint8_as_floatX, encode );
8360 stbir__simdfX_madd_mem( e1, STBIR_simd_point5X, STBIR_max_uint8_as_floatX, encode+stbir__simdfX_float_count );
8361 stbir__encode_simdfX_unflip( e0 );
8362 stbir__encode_simdfX_unflip( e1 );
8363 #ifdef STBIR_SIMD8
8364 stbir__simdf8_pack_to_16bytes( i, e0, e1 );
8365 stbir__simdi_store( output, i );
8366 #else
8367 stbir__simdf_pack_to_8bytes( i, e0, e1 );
8368 stbir__simdi_store2( output, i );
8369 #endif
8370 encode += stbir__simdfX_float_count*2;
8371 output += stbir__simdfX_float_count*2;
8372 if ( output <= end_output )
8373 continue;
8374 if ( output == ( end_output + stbir__simdfX_float_count*2 ) )
8375 break;
8376 output = end_output; // backup and do last couple
8377 encode = end_encode_m8;
8378 }
8379 return;
8380 }
8381
8382 // try to do blocks of 4 when you can
8383 #if stbir__coder_min_num != 3 // doesn't divide cleanly by four
8384 output += 4;
8385 STBIR_NO_UNROLL_LOOP_START
8386 while( output <= end_output )
8387 {
8388 stbir__simdf e0;
8389 stbir__simdi i0;
8390 STBIR_NO_UNROLL(encode);
8391 stbir__simdf_load( e0, encode );
8392 stbir__simdf_madd( e0, STBIR__CONSTF(STBIR_simd_point5), STBIR__CONSTF(STBIR_max_uint8_as_float), e0 );
8393 stbir__encode_simdf4_unflip( e0 );
8394 stbir__simdf_pack_to_8bytes( i0, e0, e0 ); // only use first 4
8395 *(int*)(output-4) = stbir__simdi_to_int( i0 );
8396 output += 4;
8397 encode += 4;
8398 }
8399 output -= 4;
8400 #endif
8401
8402 // do the remnants
8403 #if stbir__coder_min_num < 4
8404 STBIR_NO_UNROLL_LOOP_START
8405 while( output < end_output )
8406 {
8407 stbir__simdf e0;
8408 STBIR_NO_UNROLL(encode);
8409 stbir__simdf_madd1_mem( e0, STBIR__CONSTF(STBIR_simd_point5), STBIR__CONSTF(STBIR_max_uint8_as_float), encode+stbir__encode_order0 ); output[0] = stbir__simdf_convert_float_to_uint8( e0 );
8410 #if stbir__coder_min_num >= 2
8411 stbir__simdf_madd1_mem( e0, STBIR__CONSTF(STBIR_simd_point5), STBIR__CONSTF(STBIR_max_uint8_as_float), encode+stbir__encode_order1 ); output[1] = stbir__simdf_convert_float_to_uint8( e0 );
8412 #endif
8413 #if stbir__coder_min_num >= 3
8414 stbir__simdf_madd1_mem( e0, STBIR__CONSTF(STBIR_simd_point5), STBIR__CONSTF(STBIR_max_uint8_as_float), encode+stbir__encode_order2 ); output[2] = stbir__simdf_convert_float_to_uint8( e0 );
8415 #endif
8416 output += stbir__coder_min_num;
8417 encode += stbir__coder_min_num;
8418 }
8419 #endif
8420
8421 #else
8422
8423 // try to do blocks of 4 when you can
8424 #if stbir__coder_min_num != 3 // doesn't divide cleanly by four
8425 output += 4;
8426 while( output <= end_output )
8427 {
8428 float f;
8429 f = encode[stbir__encode_order0] * stbir__max_uint8_as_float + 0.5f; STBIR_CLAMP(f, 0, 255); output[0-4] = (unsigned char)f;
8430 f = encode[stbir__encode_order1] * stbir__max_uint8_as_float + 0.5f; STBIR_CLAMP(f, 0, 255); output[1-4] = (unsigned char)f;
8431 f = encode[stbir__encode_order2] * stbir__max_uint8_as_float + 0.5f; STBIR_CLAMP(f, 0, 255); output[2-4] = (unsigned char)f;
8432 f = encode[stbir__encode_order3] * stbir__max_uint8_as_float + 0.5f; STBIR_CLAMP(f, 0, 255); output[3-4] = (unsigned char)f;
8433 output += 4;
8434 encode += 4;
8435 }
8436 output -= 4;
8437 #endif
8438
8439 // do the remnants
8440 #if stbir__coder_min_num < 4
8441 STBIR_NO_UNROLL_LOOP_START
8442 while( output < end_output )
8443 {
8444 float f;
8445 STBIR_NO_UNROLL(encode);
8446 f = encode[stbir__encode_order0] * stbir__max_uint8_as_float + 0.5f; STBIR_CLAMP(f, 0, 255); output[0] = (unsigned char)f;
8447 #if stbir__coder_min_num >= 2
8448 f = encode[stbir__encode_order1] * stbir__max_uint8_as_float + 0.5f; STBIR_CLAMP(f, 0, 255); output[1] = (unsigned char)f;
8449 #endif
8450 #if stbir__coder_min_num >= 3
8451 f = encode[stbir__encode_order2] * stbir__max_uint8_as_float + 0.5f; STBIR_CLAMP(f, 0, 255); output[2] = (unsigned char)f;
8452 #endif
8453 output += stbir__coder_min_num;
8454 encode += stbir__coder_min_num;
8455 }
8456 #endif
8457 #endif
8458}
